Title: Lead - Retention and Engagement
Industry: Entertainment Providers, Broadcast Media Production and Distribution, and Technology, Information and Media
Description:
**Position Summary:**

The Lead, Retention and Engagement is responsible for developing and executing TOD’s customer retention, engagement, and subscriber lifecycle strategy across MENA, with the objective of reducing churn, improving renewal and reactivation rates, increasing customer engagement, and maximizing subscriber lifetime value.

The role will lead data-driven retention and lifecycle initiatives across the full customer journey, from onboarding and active engagement through renewal, churn prevention, win-back, and reactivation. Working closely with Marketing, CRM, Product, Customer Care, Analytics, Commercial, Content, Technology, and Finance, the role will identify subscriber behavior and churn drivers, develop targeted customer segments and interventions, and continuously optimize customer engagement and loyalty.

The position will also oversee the planning and execution of personalized, multi-channel lifecycle campaigns, ensuring that customer insights, content preferences, sports calendars, viewing behavior, subscription data, and commercial objectives are translated into relevant and measurable retention initiatives.

The role is accountable for monitoring key retention KPIs, including churn, renewal, reactivation, engagement, customer lifetime value, and campaign performance, and for providing actionable recommendations to improve subscriber value and long-term loyalty.

**Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

**Retention Strategy & Subscriber Lifecycle**

* Develop and lead TOD’s customer retention and lifecycle strategy across MENA markets.
* Define retention priorities, initiatives, and customer journeys across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, renewal, churn prevention, cancellation, and win-back stages.
* Identify key churn drivers and develop targeted initiatives to improve subscriber retention and loyalty.
* Build differentiated retention strategies for various customer segments, subscription types, markets, and customer value groups.
* Develop initiatives aimed at increasing subscription tenure, renewal rates, engagement, and customer lifetime value.
* Partner with relevant teams to develop proactive and reactive churn-prevention programs.
* Lead and align the retention strategy across Sports and Entertainment subscriber segments, ensuring differentiated approaches based on content consumption, customer behavior, seasonality, and commercial priorities.
* Develop retention plans around major sports tournaments, premium entertainment releases, and key content moments to maximize subscriber engagement and minimize post-event churn.

**CRM & Lifecycle Campaigns**

* Lead the planning, execution, and continuous optimization of CRM and lifecycle campaigns across email, push notifications, in-app messaging, SMS, WhatsApp, and other approved customer communication channels.
* Develop personalized customer journeys based on subscriber behavior, viewing and content consumption patterns, engagement, payment status, tenure, and predicted churn risk.
* Establish automated lifecycle journeys including onboarding, activation, engagement, renewal reminders, payment recovery, churn prevention, and win-back.
* Ensure appropriate customer segmentation and personalization to improve campaign effectiveness.
* Drive continuous A/B testing and optimization of retention communications, offers, messaging, timing, and channels.
* Ensure lifecycle communications comply with customer consent, data privacy, communication governance, and brand guidelines across MENA markets.

**Churn Management & Win-Back**

* Monitor voluntary and involuntary churn and develop strategies to reduce both.
* Design cancellation journeys and save strategies aimed at retaining customers before subscription termination.
* Develop effective win-back programs for former subscribers.
* Work with Product, Payment, Technology, and Customer Care teams to address payment failures and other causes of involuntary churn.
* Develop and recommend targeted retention offers, incentives, pricing interventions, and product propositions based on customer behavior, churn risk, customer lifetime value, and commercial viability.
* Ensure retention activities balance subscriber growth with revenue and profitability objectives.

**Data, Analytics & Performance**

* Define and monitor key retention KPIs including churn rate, renewal rate, retention rate, engagement, reactivation, customer lifetime value, campaign conversion, and subscription tenure.
* Partner closely with Data and Analytics teams to develop customer segmentation, churn prediction models, cohort analysis, and subscriber behavior insights.
* Use customer behavior, cohort analysis, churn signals, and content consumption data to identify retention opportunities, develop targeted interventions, and measure incremental customer lifetime value.
* Translate customer data and behavioral insights into actionable retention initiatives.
* Develop dashboards and regular performance reporting to track retention performance and campaign effectiveness.
* Conduct cohort and funnel analysis to identify critical points of subscriber drop-off.
* Measure incremental impact and ROI of retention initiatives.
* Establish test-and-learn frameworks to measure the incremental impact of retention initiatives and identify scalable best practices.
* Partner with Analytics teams to improve churn propensity modelling, customer lifetime value modelling, and next-best-action capabilities.

**Customer Experience & Engagement**

* Work closely with Product, Content, and Customer Care teams to identify opportunities to improve the overall subscriber experience.
* Use customer feedback, behavioral data, contact-center insights, cancellation reasons, and engagement data to identify areas affecting subscriber satisfaction and retention.
* Develop engagement initiatives around key sports, entertainment, and content moments to maximize active usage and subscriber loyalty.
* Support personalization and recommendation initiatives aimed at increasing customer engagement.
* Ensure retention strategies reflect differences in customer behavior and preferences across MENA markets.
* Define and implement subscriber engagement strategies designed to increase platform usage, content discovery, viewing frequency, and overall customer stickiness.
* Develop engagement programs tailored to different customer segments, content preferences, and stages of the subscriber lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to increase engagement among low-activity or at-risk subscribers before they enter the cancellation journey.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Marketing, Product, Commercial, Content, Customer Care, Technology, Finance, and Analytics teams to deliver retention initiatives.
* Work with Customer Care teams to establish appropriate save offers, cancellation handling procedures, and retention scripts.
* Collaborate with Product and Technology teams to improve subscriber journeys, cancellation flows, payment journeys, and customer engagement features.
* Partner with Finance and Commercial teams to assess the financial impact of retention offers and initiatives.
* Coordinate with acquisition teams to ensure customer quality, retention performance, and lifetime value are considered alongside subscriber acquisition.
* Partner with Content teams to align retention and engagement activity with major sports rights, tournaments, entertainment launches, and content calendars.

**Planning & Leadership**

* Own the retention roadmap and ensure timely execution of agreed initiatives.
* Lead, coach, and develop the Retention and Engagement team, setting clear objectives, accountabilities, and performance expectations.
* Ensure effective workload allocation and collaboration between Sports Retention and Entertainment Retention specialists.
* Build team capability in CRM, lifecycle marketing, analytics, experimentation, and customer engagement best practices Establish clear operating processes, campaign calendars, governance, and reporting.
* Manage relevant agencies, CRM and technology vendors, and external partners while maintaining strong internal ownership of retention strategy, delivery, measurement, and critical CRM capabilities.
* Stay informed of developments in OTT, subscription businesses, CRM, customer lifecycle management, personalization, and retention best practices.
* Present retention performance, key insights, risks, and recommendations to senior management.

**Job Requirements and Qualifications**

**Education:**

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business Administration, Digital Marketing, Analytics, Economics, or a related field. Master’s degree or relevant professional certification in CRM, Digital Marketing, Customer Analytics, or related disciplines is advantageous.

**Experience:**

* Typically, 8 years of relevant experience in customer retention, CRM, lifecycle marketing, customer growth, subscription management, or digital marketing.
* Experience within OTT, streaming, publishing, subscription apps, digital memberships, telecommunications, digital platforms, media, entertainment, e-commerce, or other subscription-based businesses is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams, specialists, or major cross-functional retention and CRM initiatives.
* Strong understanding of subscription economics, churn management, customer lifetime value, and customer engagement.
* Proven hands-on experience building, managing, and optimizing automated lifecycle journeys using CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Insider, Braze, Iterable, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or equivalent.
* Strong experience working with customer segmentation, behavioral data, campaign analytics, and performance measurement.
* Experience working across multiple markets, preferably within the MENA region.
* Previous team leadership or project leadership experience is preferred.
* Strong hands-on experience with CRM, marketing automation, customer data, and lifecycle management platforms.
* Demonstrated experience translating customer analytics and behavioral insights into measurable commercial outcomes.
* Experience managing retention strategies across multiple customer segments, products, or content propositions.
* Strong commercial understanding of subscription models, pricing, promotional offers, and customer lifetime value.

Description:
At IMCO, our talent is among the best! IMCO offers a uniquely stimulating and rewarding environment where you can help build and drive organizational transformation, all while seeking to challenge yourself, learn, and grow your career.

The Manager, AI Platform Observability & Monitoring owns the operational management and health of IMCO’s enterprise AI platforms, with a focus on observability, reliability, performance, usage and cost. The role works closely with Architecture, Cybersecurity, AI Governance and technology teams to ensure AI platforms operate within established enterprise standards and guardrails.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**AI Platform Operations & Observability**

* Establish and manage enterprise observability and monitoring capabilities across Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Agent 365, Power Platform AI services, and future AI platforms.
* Establish and continuously improve monitoring and observability across AI platforms, models and agents, including performance, reliability, agent activity, usage and operational risks.
* Develop dashboards, alerts and KPIs that provide visibility into platform health, adoption, usage, capacity and cost.
* Identify and coordinate resolution of platform incidents and production issues, maintaining appropriate runbooks, support procedures and service expectations.

**Platform Management & Controls**

* Establish and maintain platform standards covering environments, connectors, capacity, solution management and enterprise use of Copilot Studio and Power Platform.
* Implement and operate platform controls and guardrails aligned with Architecture, Cybersecurity, AI Governance, Privacy and Technology Risk requirements.
* Maintain appropriate access, environment and platform management practices to support secure and scalable use.
* Partner with Architecture, Cybersecurity, Data Governance and AI Governance to ensure the platforms remain aligned with enterprise standards.

**Solution Lifecycle and Operational Readiness**

* Establish lifecycle and operational practices for AI and Power Platform solutions, including development, testing, deployment, release and production support.
* Maintain appropriate ALM, source control and deployment practices, including Azure DevOps integration where applicable.
* Lead operational-readiness assessments for solutions entering production, ensuring monitoring, support, recovery and ownership are in place.
* Manage platform releases, upgrades and changes and support the transition of new solutions into ongoing operations.

**Service Management & Operational Insights**

* Maintain visibility into AI consumption, licensing, platform capacity, costs, reliability and operational effectiveness.
* Provide management reporting and operational insights to support technology, governance and risk decisions.
* Manage operational relationships and service escalations with Microsoft and other relevant platform vendors.
* Evaluate emerging platform-management and observability capabilities that can improve the reliability and operation of IMCO’s AI environment.

**What you need to succeed:**

* 7+ years of experience in enterprise platform operations, cloud services, application operations or digital workplace technologies.
* Strong experience with the Microsoft ecosystem, including Microsoft 365, Azure, Power Platform and enterprise cloud services.
* Hands-on experience with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, enterprise AI platforms, conversational AI or agent-based solutions.
* Demonstrated experience with monitoring, observability, telemetry, incident management and operational reporting for enterprise platforms or applications.
* Experience with Application Lifecycle Management (ALM), DevOps, release management and production support practices.
* Experience establishing and operating platform controls, environment management, support models and operational standards.
* Strong understanding of service health, reliability, capacity, usage and cost management for cloud-based platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work across Architecture, Cybersecurity, AI Governance, Risk and business teams.
* Strong problem-solving, stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate operational data into actionable insights.

**Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may also be considered.
* Relevant Microsoft certifications across Power Platform, Azure, Microsoft 365, Copilot Studio or AI are considered assets.

Title: Senior Security Manager, Assistance
Description:
**About the role**
------------------

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic **Senior Security Manager, Assistance** to lead our regional Security Assistance team, based in Dubai.

This is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing the delivery of frontline security assistance services across Mashreq, Iran, East and Southern Africa. The successful candidate will provide strategic and operational leadership, ensuring the delivery of high-quality security advice, case management, incident response, crisis support and preventative security services to our clients and members.

Working closely with the Global Security Director, Assistance, Regional Operations Directors and wider global security network, you will drive operational excellence, strengthen regional capabilities and ensure consistent service delivery in line with International SOS standards and client expectations.

You will also play an important role in developing regional security talent, supporting business growth, strengthening client relationships and maintaining operational readiness in an evolving security environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Management and Leadership**

* Provide leadership, direction and oversight to Security Managers, Security Specialists and associated security personnel across the region.
* Lead, coach and develop regional security teams, promoting professional growth, engagement and high performance.
* Oversee performance management, objective setting, succession planning and workforce development.
* Ensure effective resource planning and allocation to meet operational demands and client requirements.
* Drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, operational excellence and customer focus.
* Lead the Security Case Lead function in coordination with Security Managers.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, training and retention of regional security personnel.
* Act as deputy to the Global Security Director, Assistance, in the Middle East region.

**Core Client & Internal Support:**

* Oversee the delivery of regional security assistance services, ensuring timely, effective and customer-focused outcomes.
* Provide expert security guidance and support to clients, travellers, expatriates and internal stakeholders.
* Maintain oversight of security case management and ensure consistent service quality and operational standards.
* Act as a senior escalation point for complex security cases, incidents and operational challenges.
* Coordinate security responses to emergencies, critical incidents and crisis situations.
* Monitor regional security developments and ensure operational responses reflect current threat assessments and intelligence.
* Provide senior-level review and quality assurance of security advice, assessments and recommendations.
* Maintain regional operational preparedness plans, procedures and response protocols.
* Oversee regional security provider networks, partnerships and the Secure Hotel Programme.
* Support Incident Management Teams and Crisis Management Teams during major incidents and events.
* Promote effective collaboration across Medical, Operations, Travel, Aviation, Network Services and Intelligence & Analysis teams.

**Consulting Delivery & Sales, Marketing Support**

* Deliver high-quality security consulting services in line with client requirements.
* Contribute to the development and delivery of security risk assessments, country assessments, travel security programmes and tailored client solutions.
* Participate in client meetings, presentations, workshops and business development engagements.
* Deliver security briefings, webinars, training programmes and awareness sessions.
* Support the preparation of proposals, tenders and commercial opportunities.
* Contribute to client retention through expert advice and excellent service delivery.
* Identify opportunities to enhance existing services and develop new client value propositions.
* Represent International SOS at relevant industry events, conferences and stakeholder meetings.
* Support regional commercial objectives through security expertise and operational insight

**Required Experience & Skills**
--------------------------------

* At least 8 years of experience in security operations and planning, including operational deployment in hostile and/or challenging environments.
* Experience gained within private security companies, military, NGOs, government or relevant private-sector organisations, ideally within the Middle East.
* Proven experience in leading and managing security teams, including remote or hybrid teams.
* Strong experience in planning and managing security assistance operations.
* Extensive knowledge of security risk management principles and best practices across diverse risk environments.
* Strong understanding of the political, security and threat landscape across the Middle East and wider region.
* Experience in conducting security risk assessments and developing practical risk mitigation strategies.
* Ability to analyse complex security, logistical and threat-related information and translate findings into clear recommendations and action plans.
* Experience preparing reports and providing advice to senior management and decision-makers.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and cross-cultural collaboration skills.
* Strong IT proficiency, including Microsoft Office applications.

**Desirable Experience**

* Crisis management and emergency response experience.
* Security consulting and training delivery.
* Client-facing presentations, public speaking and media engagement.
* Business development and commercial support.
* Quality management and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications & Education**
------------------------------

* Degree-level education in Security Studies, Conflict Studies, International Politics, International Relations or a related discipline, or equivalent professional training and experience.
* Accreditation or membership with a recognised regional security or risk management professional body is desirable.

**Languages**
-------------

* Excellent written and spoken English is essential.
* Arabic, French or another European language would be an advantage.

**Why Join International SOS?**
-------------------------------

Join a global organisation where your expertise can make a meaningful difference in protecting people and supporting organisations operating in complex environments.

At International SOS, you will work alongside experienced professionals across a global network, contribute to critical security operations and help deliver services that protect the health, safety and security of people worldwide.

**If you are an experienced security leader looking for an opportunity to make an impact on a regional and global scale, we would like to hear from you.**

Title: Global Travel Operations & Transformation Manager
Description:
**Who are we?**
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
  
  
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
  
  
A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Manager, Global Travel Operations & Transformation drives operations and traveler support, ensure consistent service delivery while advancing technology and program transformation. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Global Travel, this role translates program strategy into scalable operational programs, technology enhancements, and measurable outcomes for a global workforce.
  
  
This is a hands-on operational leadership role responsible for managing traveler support, resolving complex issues and escalations, monitoring TMC and supplier performance, and ensuring changes are successfully implemented across the global platform.
  
  
This leader manages day-to-day program performance, advances transformation initiatives, and brings forward emerging capabilities that can improve how employees plan, book, and experience business travel. The ideal candidate is proactive, data-driven, service-oriented, and energized by learning, testing, and embracing new technology, including artificial intelligence and automation. Success requires balancing traveler experience, cost stewardship, policy compliance, duty of care, and operational efficiency while consistently delivering best-in-class service at a global scale.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Global Travel Operations & Service Excellence
  
  

* Manage and continuously improve global travel operations, ensuring reliable, consistent, and traveler-centered service across regions and time zones
* Oversee traveler support, case triage, escalations, service recovery, and issue resolution, with clear accountability and follow-through
* Identify recurring traveler pain points and implement preventive, scalable solutions through knowledge content, process improvements, self-service, and technology
* Monitor program performance, traveler feedback, service levels, and operational trends to proactively address risks and opportunities
* Balance employee experience, cost effectiveness, policy compliance, and duty of care in operational decisions

Program Transformation, Technology & AI
  
  

* Partner with the Senior Manager, Global Travel, to execute the future vision for travel services at Equinix
* Lead transformation initiatives that modernize travel processes, improve the online booking experience, and create simpler, more intuitive traveler journeys
* Identify, evaluate, and help implement emerging technology, artificial intelligence, automation, predictive analytics, and self-service capabilities that improve traveler support and program efficiency
* Build practical use cases for AI and new technology, support responsible adoption, and measure impact on service quality, productivity, and traveler experience
* Stay current on corporate travel trends and digital capabilities, bringing forward recommendations that support continuous program evolution
* Promote a learning mindset by testing new approaches, applying lessons quickly, and helping stakeholders embrace change

Supplier & Service Delivery Management
  
  

* Manage operational relationships with the travel management company and other travel service providers, including performance reviews, escalations, service-level accountability, and continuous improvement
* Use scorecards, service data, traveler feedback, and root-cause analysis to strengthen supplier performance and drive sustainable solutions
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external partners on program changes, implementations, testing, and adoption

Data, Insights & Executive Communication
  
  

* Develop and maintain reporting, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide visibility into travel spend, booking behavior, online booking adoption, service performance, policy compliance, and traveler experience
* Translate complex data into concise insights, recommendations, and action plans for leaders and global stakeholders
* Create executive-ready presentations and business reviews that clearly communicate performance, risks, opportunities, decisions, and outcomes
* Improve data quality and reporting discipline to strengthen business decisions and program governance

Global Collaboration & Change Leadership
  
  

* Partner across Corporate Security, Finance, Procurement, HR, Events, Legal, Technology, and regional teams to deliver a cohesive global travel experience
* Translate strategic objectives into clear workplans, operating rhythms, communications, and measurable deliverables
* Lead change management and traveler communications for policy, process, supplier, and technology changes. Influence stakeholders across a matrixed global organization, driving alignment while balancing enterprise standards with local market requirements
* Serve as a thought partner to the Senior Manager, Global Travel by surfacing emerging trends, operational insights, and innovation opportunities

**Qualifications**

* Proven years of progressive experience in corporate travel, travel operations, travel technology, employee services, supplier management, or related field
* Experience managing complex programs or operations across multiple countries or regions
* Demonstrated success leading operational improvements, technology implementations, or transformation initiatives
* Experience managing online booking tools, travel technologies, digital platforms, or service providers
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with experience using data to identify opportunities and drive action
* Excellent program management, organization, prioritization, and issue-resolution skills
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, global, and highly matrixed environment
* Experience supporting a large global workforce and delivering services across multiple regions and time zones
* Experience with artificial intelligence, automation, self-service, predictive analytics, or other emerging technology capabilities
* Experience developing dashboards, operational scorecards, and executive reporting
* Knowledge of travel policy governance, duty of care, travel risk management, and global travel industry practices
* Experience managing strategic supplier relationships, performance metrics, and service-level commitments
* Experience with user acceptance testing, requirements gathering, documentation, communications, and change management

**Key Responsibilities**

* Delivery Ownership & Execution

* Integrated Planning: Develop and maintain the integrated initiative roadmap and master schedule, identifying all cross-project and cross-team dependencies.

* Executive Reporting: Provide timely, transparent, and concise status reporting to executive sponsors and governance bodies, focusing on progress against outcomes, key risks, and resource utilization.

* Expectation Alignment: Manage expectations of all internal and external stakeholders regarding timelines, scope, quality, and resource availability.
* Governance & Process Improvement
* Resource Management: Work with functional managers and resource leads to forecast, secure, and monitor resource capacity and allocation across all initiative components.

* Continuous Improvement: Lead retrospectives and post-mortem reviews at the initiative level to capture lessons learned and drive long-term process and framework improvements across the organization.

+ Define the scope of the project in collaboration with senior management and identify the key drivers and measurements which will be used to evaluate the project upon completion

+ Lead the project team in re-estimating project effort and costs at the appropriate gates, obtaining approval on any revisions

+ Keeping documentation on the project management lifecycle (PMLC) processes up-to-date and relevant

* Executive-Level Communication: Ability to distill intricate technical or delivery complexities into clear, concise, and actionable intelligence for senior leadership.
* Risk & Dependency Mapping: Highly proficient in identifying, visualizing, and proactively managing critical dependencies and risks across dozens of workstreams and teams.
* Tool Proficiency: Advanced expertise in enterprise project management toolsets (e.g., SmartSheets, Google Suite, Jira) for sophisticated tracking and reporting.

**Nice to Have:**

Title: Middle East Tech Business Manager

Description:

Founded by Gabrielle Chanel in 1910, CHANEL is a French luxury house renowned for its timeless elegance and innovation across Fashion, Fragrance & Beauty, and Watches & Fine Jewelry.
  
  
The Europe Region brings together several markets to distribute CHANEL’s creations and deliver the ultimate luxury experience to our clients.
  
  
Headquartered in Dubai, the Middle East Market covers nine countries: United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Lebanon, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Bahrain, Kuwait, Egypt and Jordan.
  
  
We are looking for a Middle East Tech Business Manager to support both the operational excellence and continued technology transformation of the Market.
  
  
Reporting to the Head of Digital and Tech, the Middle East Tech Business Manager acts as
**a Tech business partner for the Middle East Market, connecting local business priorities with the Europe Tech Roadmap.**
The role is responsible for ensuring the reliable, secure and effective delivery of IT infrastructure and technology services across the Market's business environments, including boutiques, wholesale operations, the distribution center and headquarters.
  
  
These services include end-user equipment, connectivity, servers, retail systems, meeting rooms, video-conferencing solutions and digital workplace technologies.
  
  
The Tech Business Manager leads a team of four people, one internal employee and three external resources. He/she is responsible for organizing, developing and evolving the team and its capabilities in line with changing business and technology needs, while managing the Tech budget, procurement activities, vendors and partners and ensuring a high level of service and delivery.
  
  
What impact you can create at CHANEL
  
  
Beyond operational excellence, the Tech Business Manager partners closely with Retail, business functions and Digital & Data teams to enable technology-driven transformation across the Market. The role contributes to Retail and business projects, identifies opportunities where technology can address business challenges, and supports the deployment and adoption of new technologies, including emerging AI capabilities.
  
  
As an ambassador for the Tech department, the Tech Business Manager ensures that the house technology strategies and standards are translated into relevant and effective solutions for the Middle East, while bringing local business needs and opportunities back into Europe Tech roadmaps.
  
  
**As an ambassador for the Tech department, act as a trusted Tech partner to the Middle East business, developing a strong understanding of business and Retail priorities, challenges and opportunities.**
Maintain close proximity to the business and Retail teams by regularly visiting boutiques and other sites, understanding user journeys and technology-related pain points, and proactively identifying opportunities for improvement.
  
  
Monitor user satisfaction with Tech services provided, identify areas for improvement and recommend appropriate actions.
  
  
Translate local business needs into clear technology requirements and use cases,
**connecting the relevant local and Europe teams and contributing to the evolution of technology roadmaps.**
Proactively identify opportunities to simplify, automate and improve Tech services, enhancing both operational efficiency and employee experience. Ensure appropriate business continuity and resilience of critical Market technology services.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
Operational Excellence / Run
  
  
Enable local teams to work effectively by providing reliable devices, including tills, printers, laptops and mobile phones, infrastructure including network equipment and servers, and standard applications across boutiques, offices and other physical locations.
  
  
Ensure contractors and partners deliver high-quality Tech support and meet agreed Service Level Agreements.
  
  
Secure and continuously optimize Tech infrastructure and support operations across boutiques and wholesale businesses for all CHANEL divisions, Fashion, Fragrance & Beauty and Watches & Fine Jewelry, as well as Corporate functions including HR and Finance.
  
  
Accompany the Tech Transformation
  
  
Contribute and maintain the Middle East Tech roadmap and project portfolio, including budget, and demands prioritization with Europe Region and Middle East business teams.
  
  
Oversee the local implementation of Tech applications and services within the Market, ensuring local requirements are understood and addressed.
  
  
Partner with Retail and business teams on technology-enabled transformation initiatives, helping translate business needs into technology solutions and ensuring their technical feasibility, integration and successful implementation.
  
  
Contribute to the exploration and implementation of new technologies that can enhance client, employee and business experiences, working closely with Digital, Data and Europe Tech teams.
  
  
Contribute to real-estate projects, primarily boutique openings and renovations, as well as office and logistics projects. Oversee the implementation of technology components, including hardware and software installation and validation, and manage suppliers and subcontractors in close coordination with Regional and Global teams.
  
  
AI & Emerging Technologies
  
  
Act as the local Tech partner for AI and emerging technology adoption, working closely with Digital, Data, business teams and Europe Tech.
  
  
Contribute to AI acculturation across the Market by helping teams understand available capabilities, opportunities, boundaries and responsible usage.
  
  
Partner with Business & Digital teams to identify and assess relevant AI and technology use cases, supporting experimentation and a test-and-learn approach.
  
  
Support the technical assessment and implementation of prioritized use cases, ensuring appropriate integration, security, architecture and compliance.
  
  
**Connect local opportunities and learnings with Europe Tech teams.**
Cybersecurity & Compliance
  
  
Implement cybersecurity guidelines in coordination with Global and Regional Cybersecurity teams and support initiatives to strengthen cybersecurity awareness among end users.
  
  
Ensure Global data protection and technology compliance requirements are appropriately implemented within the Market, working with the relevant teams and addressing local requirements where applicable.
  
  
Promote responsible technology usage across the organization, particularly as new digital and AI capabilities are introduced.
  
  
Team Management & Capability Development
  
  
Develop and engage the team, creating clear responsibilities, effective ways of working and strong accountability for service and delivery.
  
  
Manage internal and external resources, ensuring the appropriate balance of capabilities, capacity and expertise.
  
  
Create a collaborative, service-oriented and forward-looking Tech culture, encouraging proximity to users, curiosity, continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.
  
  
Budget & Partnerships Management
  
  
Contribute to annual Tech budget planning, oversee procurement and track actual expenditure, providing management with appropriate visibility over technology costs, investments and priorities.
  
  
Identify and establish relationships and contracts with local technology partners when required, in coordination with the Europe Tech team.
  
  
Ensure external partners meet agreed service, quality, security and contractual commitments.
  
  
Energizers
  
  
  

* Proven ability to build relationships with and manage key stakeholders.
* Good Understanding of the organization’s goals and objectives.
* Be able to understand business challenges and how IT can help to solve them.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively across teams and build strong relationships within an international and matrix organization to drive business outcomes.
* Results-oriented, with a can-do mindset and strong problem-solving skills, adapting quickly to deliver effective solutions while ensuring alignment with IT standards.
* Client-oriented, ensuring users feel supported and valued while communicating technical topics in a clear and accessible way.
* Ability to work well under pressure and manage internal and external collaborators.

What you can bring
  
  
  

* Master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in IT Management in a customer-facing role, with a proven track record of success.
* Excellent communication in English. The knowledge of another language of the Region is a plus.
* Strong knowledge of IT Service Management principles and IT operations.
* Strong experience of project management and ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and requests simultaneously.
* Knowledge of cloud-based technologies, networking, and database management.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Windows 11, M365 services and Linux operating systems and their management platforms.
* Knowledge of Service Now and Microsoft Intune is a plus.
* Certification in relevant IT fields is a plus.

What you will gain
  
  
  

* Team spirit and an inspiring company culture.
* Individual development opportunities and training.

At Chanel, we are focused on creating an inclusive culture that nurtures personal growth, contributing to collective progress. We believe the uniqueness of each individual increases the diversity, complementarity and effectiveness of our teams. We strongly encourage your application, as we value the perspective, experience and potential you could bring to CHANEL.
  
  
We look forward to receiving your application (including references, notice period and your salary expectations) via our career website.

Title: Manager, Customer Value Management

We are looking for a CVM Manager to lead Samsung Gulf Electronics' Customer Value Management engagement with Telecom Operators across the GCC (UAE, Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman and Qatar). Based in Dubai, this regional role designs and runs data-driven base management and lifecycle programs that operators use to grow the value of their existing customers, positioning Samsung as a value partner that brings device, ecosystem and customer insight to those programs.

**How You Will Make An Impact:**

**Strategy & Operator Partnership**

* Act as Samsung's lead for CVM topics with operator CVM and base management teams across five markets, reporting to the Head of CRM & Analytics.
* Develop the GCC CVM strategy and annual joint operator plans, with agreed KPIs and governance in each market.
* Co-design base management and lifecycle programs covering segmentation, offers, channel mix and contact frequency, from acquisition and onboarding through retention, win-back and churn prevention.
* Lead quarterly business reviews, joint steering committees and commercial negotiations on scope, funding and timelines.

**Customer Insight & Analytics**

* Translate Samsung Customer Profile Insights into operator-ready use cases, such as device upgrade propensity, ecosystem affinity and next-best-offer recommendations.
* Apply AI and advanced analytics (propensity, churn and uplift models) with operator analytics teams, within agreed data-sharing rules.
* Structure test-and-learn programs with control groups, and report ROI monthly and in flight.

**Business Case & Growth**

* Build the commercial business case for each program, including Samsung investment, co-funding options and expected return.
* Drive Galaxy device upgrades and ecosystem adoption (Galaxy Watch, Buds, Tablets and services), TVs and loyalty, with measurable ROI in every market.
* Deliver a monthly CVM performance review with clear recommendations for senior leadership.

**Market Intelligence & Partnerships**

* Track telecom market dynamics (tariffs, competitor offers, 5G and fiber, eSIM, device financing and regulation) and adapt the CVM plan accordingly.
* Coordinate with Samsung Gulf product, sales, marketing, service, legal and privacy teams, and with HQ and RHQ CVM and data teams.
* Manage external partners (agencies, CVM platform vendors and data partners) to deliver on time and to budget.
* Build a regional GCC CVM playbook and share best practice across the Samsung CRM and analytics community.
* Keep all data sharing compliant with regional data-protection laws (UAE PDPL, Qatar PDPL, Bahrain PDPL) and operator privacy requirements.

**What You'll Need:**

* Minimum 7 years of professional experience, including at least 5 years in Customer Value Management, base management, retention, CRM or lifecycle marketing, with at least 3 of those years within a Telecom Operator or as a partner to one (OEM, agency or vendor).
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Economics, Data Analytics or a related field. A Master's degree or MBA is preferred.
* Hands-on experience leading CVM, base management or lifecycle programs at a Telecom Operator, including campaign design, execution and ROI measurement.
* Solid command of telecom base KPIs: ARPU, churn, net adds, CLV, usage, upgrade rates and tariff migration.
* Experience with CVM or campaign platforms and marketing automation (e.g., Teradata, Adobe, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Amdocs or Netcracker), with working knowledge of telecom BSS and billing systems.

Title: Strategic Account Manager
Description:
**About Orium**
---------------

Orium builds smart, modern commerce solutions for enterprise brands. We're the leading composable commerce consultancy and systems integrator in the Americas, with more composable launches than any firm in the region, and a member of the MACH Alliance. We combine AI, data and composable systems so people and intelligent agents can work together, and we partner with best-in-class technology providers including commercetools, Stripe and Contentstack across three lines of business: Commerce, DXP and Agentic.

We're a remote-first company with team members across the Americas. A certified BCorp for over a decade, we're based in Toronto, and in June 2024 we acquired the Mexico-based ecommerce agency Gluo.

**About the Opportunity**
-------------------------

Orium is seeking a senior Strategic Account Manager to be the trusted partner for some of our most important enterprise clients. You'll own a small portfolio of complex accounts, be the person clients call when things get hard, and help them see their problems in a new way.

You're at your best in the room with senior stakeholders, whether you're leading a workshop, resetting expectations or making the case for what comes next. You'd rather go deep with a handful of clients than chase new logos, and you measure success by the trust you earn and the accounts you grow.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own 5 to 8 priority enterprise accounts as the main commercial contact and trusted advisor
* Act as the senior escalation point, leading honest conversations when expectations, scope or budgets need resetting, and getting relationships back on track
* Lead and participate in client workshops, steering committees, roadmap planning and quarterly business reviews, challenging assumptions and reframing problems when a client is heading the wrong way
* Drive account growth through renewals and expansion across our Commerce, DXP and Agentic practices, including partner-led opportunities with commercetools, Stripe and Contentstack
* Shape new opportunities with our delivery and strategy teams, from problem statement through pitch and SOW
* Help clients move from project work into ongoing optimization and managed services
* Develop and maintain account plans and forecasts in partnership with sales leadership
* Maintain strong working relationships with delivery teams to keep engagements on scope, high quality and aligned to client goals and KPIs
* Use AI tools for account research, meeting prep and opportunity spotting
* Travel to meet clients and partners across the Americas as needed

**Skills and Qualifications**
-----------------------------

* 5+ years in client-facing, revenue-accountable roles such as Account Director, Client Partner, Strategic Account Manager or Customer Success leader
* Experience at a professional services firm, agency, systems integrator or B2B SaaS company
* A track record of managing senior enterprise relationships through difficult moments, and coming out with more trust than before
* Experience working with B2B clients
* Confidence leading workshops and executive conversations, and the creativity to turn what a client asks for into a better problem to solve
* Proven ability to grow accounts through renewals and expansion, and comfort owning a revenue number
* Strong commercial judgment across scope, margin and forecast
* Knowledge of the digital commerce landscape, including composable commerce, modular DXP and emerging AI and agentic technologies, is an asset
* Experience with modern digital tools and an openness to integrating AI-powered solutions into your daily work\*
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to critically evaluate AI-assisted decisions and workflows\*
* A mindset of continuous learning and the ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and trends\*
* Based in Canada

* AI expectations will vary by role. Some positions focus on AI exploration and experimentation, while leadership roles may drive AI adoption and strategy.

**Is this Role a Fit for You?**
-------------------------------

The role emphasizes trusted client relationships, commercial acumen and creative problem solving. We value people with a maker's attitude, collaborative energy and entrepreneurial spirit. You'll find fulfillment in the role if you...

* **Are passionate about client relationships.** You can't sleep properly if we might miss a commitment, and you're the first to pick up the phone when something goes sideways.
* **Stay calm and direct in hard conversations.** You know that honest, well-timed conversations build more trust than avoiding them.
* **Love reframing the problem.** You get curious about the need behind the request and enjoy helping clients see a better path forward.
* **Have an interest in making the business work.** You're an entrepreneur at heart and see account growth as the result of delivering real value.
* **Prefer depth over volume.** You'd rather build long-term relationships with a few clients than chase new logos.
* **Thoroughly enjoy collaborative work.** You partner closely with delivery, strategy and sales, and you put the team's success first.
* **Are naturally curious about AI.** You look for ways to use AI and automation to work smarter, without losing the human touch.

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

* Enjoy a flexible schedule of full-time hours. As a remote-first organization, we care about the work you do, but it's up to you to choose where and how you do it.
* Explore ongoing opportunities for professional development: training, conferences, certifications and in-house peer mentorship.
* Experiment with new techniques, wear multiple hats and learn about new disciplines.
* Pursue independent projects, explore new ideas and challenge yourself in your field with dedicated "Awesome Time" (self-directed professional development) annually and quarterly training budgets.
* On top of standard medical and dental coverage, we offer benefits like a parental leave top-up plan, an EAP, mental health coverage, virtual healthcare and a minimum vacation policy.
* Our Toronto HQ is a modern, ergonomic space with hotelling standing/sitting desks and an open-concept social atmosphere.
* Additional perks include in-house mindfulness sessions, remote group get-togethers and more!

The Canada base salary range for this role is $120,000 - $140,000 CAD, plus variable compensation of $30,000 - $40,000 CAD at target, for total On Target Earnings of $150,000 - $180,000 CAD. Orium lists this range in good faith, reflecting the expected compensation for this role in the specified locations as of this posting. The pay offered will depend on several relevant factors, such as education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, location and business needs. Please note, this range does not include any benefits that may be included as part of the total compensation package.

**Performance and Growth Expectations**
---------------------------------------

We emphasize accountability for outcomes, but autonomy in activities. Your work will be measured across a number of data points (peer, leader and project team feedback) and on the basis of client and user satisfaction. Your growth path is in your hands: you'll have ongoing meetings with your leader to help determine your path, but your progress will be based on what you hope to achieve and how you choose to access the resources available to you.

**Committed to an Inclusive Workplace**
---------------------------------------

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible environment as we build a workforce that reflects the diversity of the community in which we live, including those with disabilities. We are dedicated to providing accommodations in all parts of the hiring process in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act and the Ontario Human Rights Code. If you require any accommodation, we will work with you to meet your needs.

Orium uses AI tools for candidate communications, scheduling, interview notes and feedback summaries. Humans review all information and make every hiring decision.

**Committed to Social and Environmental Stewardship**
-----------------------------------------------------

Orium is committed to promoting and working towards a more socially and environmentally sustainable future. All employees are expected to make decisions and take actions in relation to their role and work that follow through on this commitment.

Title: Portfolio Delivery Leader
Description:
Company Overview:

Job Description :

**This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the U.S**

We are standing up a product-led, agile-based operating model for Infrastructure, and we are looking for a Release Train Engineer and Portfolio Delivery Lead to run delivery across the organization. This person works across five agile teams (platform areas), carries portfolio-level visibility, and helps define and own the operating model as we build it. It is a foundational role: you will not inherit a mature train, you will help stand one up.

**About the role**

Infrastructure & Cloud is moving from a project-based structure to a product-led model built on five agile teams (platform areas) spanning cloud, network, reliability, developer experience, and data. The Release Train Engineer is the connective tissue across those teams: the person who makes cross-team delivery predictable, keeps dependencies and risks visible, and gives leadership a clear line of sight into flow and progress. You will partner closely with the product director, who owns product direction and the roadmap, while you own the cadence, the flow, and how the teams execute together.

**What you will do**

**Run the train**

* Facilitate PSI planning and the planning cadence across the five teams, including readiness, cross-team syncs, demos, and retrospectives.
* Establish and hold a consistent delivery rhythm across teams that do not run on the same clock today.

**Manage flow, dependencies, and risk**

* Surface and manage cross-team dependencies, bottlenecks, and risks before they slow delivery.
* Keep work moving across team boundaries, and escalate what needs leadership attention.

**Portfolio and Quarterly Planning**

* Partner with Product Management, Business Teams, and Engineering leadership to facilitate quarterly planning, roadmap reviews, prioritization discussions, and portfolio planning activities.
* Facilitate quarterly planning, capacity planning, and commitment management across the portfolio, ensuring priorities, staffing, and delivery commitments remain aligned.

**Own portfolio visibility and governance**

Title: Vice President, Core Infrastrucutre
Location: Global Village, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Description:
***Posting Type***
Hybrid
  
  
**Job Overview**
Rel aiR is the high-scale, secure, and defensible platform where legal data lives. It runs on infrastructure that has to be available, economical, and compliant in every region we serve. We hold more than 100 petabytes of customer data today, and we are building for hundreds of petabytes in the next three years, scaling potentially to an exabyte within five. This is sensitive data at scale, and managing it requires a global understanding of data management.
  
  
The load is rising from multiple directions at once. More legal work is being done with the help of AI-driven software. AI is supporting more use cases across Legal Data Intelligence. MCP (Model Context Protocol) and third-party builder programs are automating more workflows. And we are moving all new matters to Rel aiR. Together these have taken the AI results we produce from millions to hundreds of millions, and we are headed to billions.
  
  
We are hiring a Vice President of Core Infrastructure to build the foundation for that growth and to join the leadership team of Engineering at Relativity. You will own SQL platform, compute (Kubernetes), reliability and operations, and incident and problem management, and build a new capacity-forecasting function.
  
  
Your strategy will span multiple data centers and multiple ways to store data. You will stay agile when cloud storage capacity is tight, adapt to data sovereignty and local requirements around the world, and work with Security to keep the fortress secure. You will work with engineering teams to raise utilization and route work to the resources available, and you will make sure we use services that meet our economic targets, and use them well.
  
  
**Job Description And Requirements**
**This is a builder’s job.**
We are 25 years old and, in many ways, still a startup. We are growing fast, and the infrastructure we need for the next five years does not exist yet. You will not inherit a mature platform to operate. You will build the strategy, the talent, and the capacity engine while the platform carries production traffic. Our Cloud Native Transformation is re-platforming Rel aiR so that every matter, including the largest and most complex, runs on a cloud-native foundation, and it depends on what you will lead. We need your help to build it and to execute it.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**

* Reliability customers can feel. Availability and recovery that match the trust customers place in us, with fewer severe incidents and faster resolution.
* Infrastructure with options. Storage and compute across multiple data centers and multiple ways to store data, with the agility to shift when cloud capacity is constrained.
* Global by design. Data placement and operations that meet data sovereignty and local requirements wherever our customers are.
* A secure fortress. Infrastructure and security decisions made together, with a close and trusted relationship between your organization and Security.
* Efficient use of capacity. Engineering teams use resources more fully, work routes to the capacity that is available, and the services we choose meet our economic targets and are used appropriately.
* Infrastructure that carries the transformation. The data and compute platform keeps pace with the Cloud Native Transformation, and structural change ships in steady increments.
* One owner from detection to fix. Incident response and problem management sit in one organization, and the same root causes stop recurring.
* A strong teammate across Engineering. You help set direction beyond your own domain and are known as a leader inside the company and across the industry.

**What You’ll Do**

* Set the vision. Define what infrastructure for a leading data company looks like, and bring your organization and your peers along.
* Own reliability end to end. Observability, site services, on-call, incident response, and problem management sit with you.
* Build the storage and compute strategy. Multiple data centers, multiple storage options, and the capacity model that shows where each choice breaks as data grows toward an exabyte.
* Manage cost as part of the job. Own the economics of the services we use, and work with Finance on how storage and AI costs affect gross margin.
* Partner with Security. Keep the fortress secure through shared priorities, shared roadmaps, and clear ownership.
* Work with engineering teams. Raise utilization, route work to available resources, and adapt to cloud storage availability and to local requirements.
* Build the organization. Recruit the leaders, set the operating rules, and decide the mix of in-house and contract teams.
* Lead across Engineering. Work daily with the leaders of data pipelines, security, AI products, and the builder platform, and take a seat in decisions that reach beyond your domain.
* Use AI to run production. Apply AI to detection, root-cause analysis, and remediation.
* Stay in touch with the details. Operate comfortably at 1,000 feet and at ground level. Go deep on a root-cause analysis or a customer escalation and find the cause. Walk to a whiteboard and sketch the architecture, including where it breaks.

**Required**
**What You Bring**

* A builder’s record. You have built strategy and talent in a fast-growing company, not only operated a mature platform.
* SaaS operations at scale. A record of running infrastructure and site reliability for a multi-tenant SaaS platform with demanding availability commitments and petabytes of customer data.
* Global data management. Experience placing and operating sensitive data across multiple regions and data centers, and meeting data sovereignty and local requirements.
* Infrastructure leadership. Led organizations of 100+ engineers across SRE, database platform, and container platform disciplines, including contractor teams.
* Cost and capacity economics. You have managed infrastructure cost against economic targets, and made build-versus-buy decisions on storage or compute at petabyte scale.
* Cloud-native depth. Kubernetes, SQL at scale, and a major public cloud. Hyperscale cloud provider experience is valuable.
* Incident leadership. You have reduced severe incidents and time to resolve in a large organization.
* Technical credibility. You can challenge an architecture, a capacity forecast, and an incident review on the merits.

**Valuable But Not Required**

* Regulated or FedRAMP-authorized environments.
* Experience with eDiscovery or other large document platforms.
* Experience in a private equity-backed company or one preparing for an IPO.

**Why Join Us**

* Own the infrastructure under the largest legal data footprint in the world, and build it for an exabyte.
* Join a 25-year-old company that still moves like a startup, with the mandate to shape the strategy and the team.
* Report to the CTO and sit on the Engineering leadership team, with direct access to the executive team and the board.
* Run a platform where an outage delays litigation, investigations, and regulatory deadlines for customers.
* Competitive compensation, including equity participation in a private equity-backed company at an inflection point.

**Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.**
This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.
  
  
The expected salary range for this role is between following values:
  
  
$240,000 and $360,000
  
  
The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.
  
  
**Required Skills**
Budget Management, Cloud Native, Cloud-Native Architecture, Cloud-Native Computing, Data Management, Data Science, Engineering Management, Innovation, Leadership, Product Management, Project Management, Risk Management, Software as a Service (SaaS), Software Development, System Designs

Title: Senior Manager - Operational Readiness - AA9

**Key competencies**

* Designing handover governance and applying it consistently across systems, vendors and projects
* Service transition and operational onboarding expertise
* Planning knowledge transfer and developing operational competency
* Commercial awareness of support contracts, warranties and third-party obligations
* Clear risk reporting, decisive escalation and confident chairing of reviews
* Proven experience across core ICT infrastructure domains, including compute, storage, backup, networking and structured cabling

Title: Executive Director, Utilities (RE1)
Description:
The Executive Director, Utilities leads the City Operations utilities mandate across Qiddiya City, covering power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, ICT, water bodies, lagoons and other utility systems within scope. The role is accountable for improving the operational management and resilience of existing interim networks, water bodies and lagoons; protecting continuity of service during construction; defining the city-wide utilities strategy, ownership model and operating standards; and ensuring permanent utility and water assets are planned, designed, delivered and accepted in line with City Operations and Qiddiya City Authority requirements. Reporting to the City Chief Operations Officer, the role coordinates closely with planning, design, delivery, district and asset teams, QTech, Smart City, utility providers, regulators and O&M partners to manage material service, capacity, water-quality, commercial and reputational risks.

**Utilities Strategy and Asset Ownership**

* Develop and implement the City Operations strategy for all utilities, water bodies and lagoons, including service outcomes, water quality, resilience, governance, ownership, operating and cost model, standards and long-term investment priorities.
* Determine which interim and permanent utility assets will be adopted by City Operations and which will be owned or operated by utilities, districts, assets or other third parties, with clear decision rights and accountability.
* Improve the operational management, asset information, condition oversight and service performance of existing interim power, potable water, renewed water and ICT networks.
* Develop and implement a protection and continuity strategy for live interim utility networks during construction, recognising that outages create a material operational and reputational risk for Qiddiya.
* Maintain an accurate city-wide utilities asset register and GIS record, including surveys of existing interim networks and requirements for any relocation arising from development works.
* Advise the City Chief Operations Officer and governance on utility priorities, delivery dependencies, capacity constraints, temporary solutions, investment needs and material operational risks.

**Planning, Design and Operational Assurance**

* Coordinate with planning, design and delivery teams to accelerate permanent utility assets needed for growing city-wide operational, development and major-event requirements.
* Define City Operations requirements and assure their incorporation into utility strategies, project briefs, designs, specifications, delivery plans and permanent-asset operating models.
* Verify that interim and full-build infrastructure can meet peak utility loads, including concurrent major-event scenarios and increased city footfall, with adequate redundancy and recovery arrangements.
* Lead operational assurance of critical dependencies and interfaces, including permanent and temporary power, potable and renewed water capacity, wastewater, stormwater, water bodies and lagoons, utility corridors, ICT connectivity and data-centre requirements.
* Coordinate space planning for utility operational centres, O&M yards, workshops and equipment and spare-parts storage, confirming the required number, location and functionality across Qiddiya City.
* Participate in multidisciplinary stage-gate reviews and challenge solutions to optimise safety, service continuity, maintainability, whole-life cost, efficiency and operational readiness.

**Readiness, Handover and Asset Acceptance**

* Establish utility readiness, testing, commissioning, handover and operational acceptance requirements, including permits, asset data, GIS records, operating procedures, warranties, spares, training and defect closure.
* Assess acceptance evidence and recommend City Operations acceptance only where ownership, operating responsibility, funding and service interfaces are clear.
* Aggregate city-wide O&M requirements and lead the technical and operational strategy for a multi-year city-wide utilities O&M services procurement, coordinating with Commercial, Procurement, Finance and Legal.
* Coordinate mobilisation and transition arrangements for interim and permanent networks, including temporary service extensions where delays to permanent assets require continued use of temporary power, water or ICT solutions.
* Ensure adopted assets are captured in the asset management system and GIS with complete, accurate and usable information for safe operation and maintenance.

**Performance, Risk and Lifecycle Management**

* Establish KPIs and executive reporting for availability, outages, reliability, water quality, water-body and lagoon condition, capacity, losses, consumption, compliance, incidents, cost, complaints and recovery performance.
* Maintain a consolidated utilities risk and dependency register covering delivery slippage, temporary-network fragility, corridor and land constraints, capacity shortfalls, construction interfaces and unbudgeted temporary solutions.
* Develop lifecycle, renewal and investment plans based on criticality, condition, service demand, resilience, regulatory requirements and whole-life value.
* Confirm the operational data required for smart utilities, align the Siemens utilities integration study with QTech and Smart City initiatives, and define requirements for monitoring, analytics and future digital-twin capability.
* Ensure emergency, outage, business continuity and recovery plans are coordinated with City Operations, districts, assets, utility providers, safety, security and event functions.

**Commercial, Regulatory and Stakeholder Management**

* Define the utilities cost-recovery model, including cost allocation, metering, tariffs or charges, billing inputs, subsidy requirements, subsidy period and governance for costs levied on operational assets.
* Lead the utility component of the city service charge in collaboration with the Executive Director, City Asset Management and Finance and Control, ensuring transparent and auditable recovery mechanisms.
* Draft and implement service level agreements between City Operations and districts or assets for utilities adopted by City Operations, including service standards, responsibilities, escalation, outage communication and performance reporting.
* Develop City Operations codes, standards and guidelines for construction in the vicinity of live utility assets, including permits, protection measures, access controls and incident response.
* Manage strategic interfaces with authorities, regulators, Saudi Electricity, water entities, telecoms providers, developers, districts, operators and specialist O&M service providers.
* Ensure statutory, technical, environmental, commercial and contractual obligations are identified, governed and evidenced across all adopted utilities.

**Leadership and Capability Building**

* Build and lead a capable municipal utilities team with clear accountability, effective governance and disciplined delivery.
* Develop Saudi talent through structured recruitment, mentoring, role exposure, succession planning and knowledge transfer from advisers, delivery partners and operators.
* Promote collaboration, technical rigour, commercial discipline, innovation and continuous improvement.

  
**Requirements**

**Education and Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, utilities, infrastructure, asset management or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification in engineering, asset management, business or a related field is advantageous.
* Relevant professional registration or accreditation in engineering, utilities, asset management or project management is preferred.

**Experience**

* Substantial executive leadership experience in city-wide utilities, infrastructure asset management or utility network development within a complex city, municipality, mixed-use destination or major development programme.
* Demonstrated experience managing live interim or temporary utility networks while permanent infrastructure is planned and delivered in an active construction environment.
* Strong experience across utility strategy, planning, design assurance, construction interfaces, testing, commissioning, handover, operational acceptance and service mobilisation.
* Proven experience in network resilience, outage management, peak-demand planning, lifecycle investment, GIS and asset information, operational data and regulatory compliance.
* Demonstrated experience developing utility O&M procurement strategies, SLAs, performance regimes, tariffs, metering, billing, cost-recovery or subsidy models.
* Proven ability to manage interfaces among developers, delivery teams, authorities, regulators, utilities, districts, operators and service providers; experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC is strongly preferred.

**Technical and Functional Expectations**

* Expert understanding of city-wide utility asset management, live-network operations and governance of networked infrastructure.
* Strong working knowledge of power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, water bodies and lagoons, ICT and associated corridors, facilities and operational dependencies.
* Ability to assess demand, capacity, reliability, redundancy, pressure and flow constraints, metering, efficiency, service continuity, emergency recovery and whole-life cost.
* Strong understanding of GIS, asset registers, operational technology, smart-utility data, analytics and digital-twin opportunities.
* Clear understanding of asset-owner, developer, regulator, network operator, O&M manager, district, asset and service-provider accountability boundaries.
* Strong commercial judgement, procurement capability, risk management, data-led decision-making and executive reporting.

Title: Director - Technical Product Management
