----------------------------------------------------------------

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025. It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Mackenzie Investments, founded in 1967, is a key part of IGM's business model, serving as a comprehensive asset-management partner for Canadian financial advisors and their clients.

**At Mackenzie Investments, we believe being invested starts with our people.** We are proud to be recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers for the fourth consecutive year and one of Canada’s Best Diversity Employers. Our vision and strategy aim to innovate the industry and support Canadians in achieving their financial goals.

Join our team to engage in continuous learning and skill development in a supportive environment. Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work environment, where you spend three days a week in the office, connecting, collaborating, and enjoying quality time with your amazing colleagues! Our Values: Be better; we strive for improvement in everything we do. Be accountable; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly. Be a team; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals.

**About the Role:**

The **Manager, Workforce Planning & Business Optimization** will be responsible for developing the forecasting, capacity modelling, performance analytics, workforce intelligence, and business integration capabilities required to support Enterprise Contact Centre service delivery across current and future channels. The role combines workforce planning expertise with advanced analytics, reporting automation, AI/automation measurement, and enterprise technology integration to enable better decisions on staffing, service levels, cost-to-serve, and transformation readiness.

This role will build the analytical and integration foundation needed to support omni-channel operations across phone, email, assisted chat, workflow, digital servicing, and AI-enabled interactions. It will own the business integration lifecycle - from use-case definition and requirements through data/API integration, testing, operational readiness, adoption, monitoring, and benefits realization - while partnering with Technology and platform teams on solution delivery. It will provide executive-ready insights that connect workforce assumptions to client experience, advisor experience, operational performance, technology outcomes, and enterprise transformation priorities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build accurate and scalable workforce models across phone, email, chat, digital channels, workflow queues, and AI-enabled work.
* Own the business integration lifecycle for WFM analytics and AI capabilities, from use-case evaluation and requirements through testing, implementation, adoption, monitoring, and benefits realization.
* Translate cloud-based and AI-enabled technical capabilities into practical workflows, functional requirements, data requirements, and operational processes.
* Improve connectivity across WFM, CCaaS, CRM, workflow, data, and enterprise platforms through governed APIs, data flows, and reusable integrations.
* Automate reporting and reduce reliance on manual downloads, spreadsheets, and one-time analysis.
* Validate the realized benefits and service impacts of automation, and AI/digital workers.
* Ensure new capabilities are scalable, reliable, resilient, secure, privacy-aligned, supportable, cost-effective, and compliant with internal standards.
* Provide decision-grade insights for monthly, quarterly, annual, and business planning cycles.
* Support service-safe transformation by identifying workforce, integration, data, and adoption risks early and recommending mitigation options.
* Advance segmentation and capacity models across IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments to align staffing with changing volume mix, service expectations, and reporting requirements.
* Build sustainable capability through integration standards, documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Economics, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in workforce planning, contact centre analytics, operations analytics, business intelligence, data science, systems integration, AI enablement, or related function.
* Experience building forecasting, capacity, performance, or scenario models and applying them to operational or strategic decisions.
* Transformation Experience operationalizing, automation, AI, or technology-enabled capability in a production or enterprise environment.
* Advanced Power BI or equivalent reporting experience, strong SQL, and advanced Excel skills.
* Experience translating business needs and analytical outputs into functional, data, or integration requirements and recommendations for operational or executive decision-making.
* Experience defining, implementing, or supporting data/API integrations across WFM, contact centre, cloud, or enterprise platforms.
* Working knowledge of cloud-based data/AI environments, system architecture concepts, data quality, security, privacy, and technology governance.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or advanced certification in Data Science, Business Analytics, AI, Technology, or a related discipline.
* Experience in financial services, wealth management, or other regulated environments, with exposure to omni-channel contact centre operations.
* Proficiency with workforce management platforms (Verint, Calabrio, NICE, Genesys), cloud technologies (AWS, Salesforce, Azure), and advanced analytics tools (Python, R, Power BI, Looker, SQL).
* Experience implementing AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives, including systems integration, operational readiness, and benefits realization.
* Strong understanding of data governance, cybersecurity, privacy, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience partnering with senior leadership to influence strategic workforce planning, technology roadmaps, and business transformation initiatives.

As this position is posted in Montréal, Toronto and Winnipeg, we specify that bilingualism (French, English, both oral and written) is required for Quebec only for the frequent interactions with English.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for annual short-term incentive, health and well-being benefits, retirement and savings plan, paid time off and career development.

Title: Senior Director of Professional Services Enterprise Delivery & Implementation| West Coast| Remote
Description:
Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best-in-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.

Ellucian is seeking a dynamic **Senior Director of Professional Services Delivery** to join our Professional Services organization. This role involves leading and overseeing the implementation of Ellucian solutions, supporting higher education institutions in Canada and the eastern United States. These strategic programs range from 1.5 to 2 years. Bring your strategic vision, enterprise program governance, execution, and leadership skills to Ellucian and make a significant impact! At Ellucian, we offer a comprehensive SaaS portfolio that helps higher education institutions navigate change, achieve transparency, and drive efficiency.

**Where You Will Make an Impact**

* Manage the Professional Services Field Delivery organization.
* Share responsibility for the North American Professional Services P&L (revenue and expenses of assigned projects) and Customer Satisfaction.
* Own financial forecasts related to delivery revenue and margin, collaborating closely with the Finance Business Partner.
* Identify business growth opportunities by leveraging knowledge of the Higher Education industry, business processes, and software products.
* Assist the Customer Success team in developing solutions and selling the value of project management services during the sales cycle.
* Drive consumption of PS orders (backlog) to accelerate time to value and maximize project profitability.
* Ensure effective execution of service delivery and achievement of customers’ desired outcomes.
* Implement project quality assurance by employing standardized processes and best practices.
* Assess risks, define mitigation plans, manage demand, and anticipate resource bottlenecks.
* Establish early-warning project management and risk management practices.
* Provide critical issue management and proactively lead project escalations, implementing measures to prevent future issues.
* Drive the vision and execution of Professional Services.
* Build strong, long-lasting relationships with customers, delivering high-value, outcome-based services that result in referenceable clients.
* Motivate, coach, and transform the Delivery team to an outcomes-based service model, delivering high NPS and project profitability.
* Promote the use of blended delivery (e.g., using Ellucian CoEs in India and Mexico or partners/subcontractors).
* Proactively engage with the North American Professional Services organization consulting practices to ensure timely delivery to contract and customer satisfaction/NPS.
* Resolve escalations by leading cross-functional team resolutions to mitigate project risks and issues.
* Monitor the health status of the Delivery region and ensure proactive risk management.
* Improve NA regional delivery team dynamics and performance through leadership, mentoring, and motivation.
* Ensure regions leverage repeatable, standard practices/processes.
* Understand the Professional Services marketplace and drive new implementation approaches throughout the organization.
* Work collaboratively with the Services team to develop and improve strategies, policies, and procedures; support and promote the use of delivery methodologies and best practices.

**Developing Our Teams**

* Lead change management activities within the Field Delivery organization to enable transformation and team growth.
* Address performance concerns with delivery leaders and provide timely performance evaluation input.
* Focus on proactive communications, cascading messages through regional leadership.
* Own the accuracy of the regional financial forecasting process (revenue, bookings, margins, expenditures, etc.).
* Monitor regional delivery KPIs (supply & demand, backlog, project profitability, PM utilization, and project health).
* Establish and monitor delivery compliance and assurance metrics underpinning project health.
* Foster a culture of skills development and employee career advancement.
* Build positive working relationships with Sales, Pre-sales, Customer Success & Support, Cloud Operations, Managed Services teams, and the Office of the COO, operating under the “One-team” approach motto across Ellucian to enhance customer service excellence.

**What You Will Bring**

* + A minimum of 12 years of progressive professional experience, including personnel management, technical leadership, and P&L ownership.
  + Demonstrable experience in resource planning and optimization; revenue recognition and EBITDA budgeting, and action planning resulting from actively managing budgets, costs, and performance.
  + Consulting or leadership position in a Professional Service Organization of a SaaS software company is required, with specific experience in moving applications from on-prem to Cloud/SaaS.
  + Project Management and Operations experience in running Professional Services in software companies.
  + Demonstrable experience in interfacing commercially and technically with partner organizations, outsourcing companies, and global coordination of remote resources and contractors.
  + Extensive experience in implementing large systems like ERPs, CRMs, Billing, HR, Logistics, or Custom Business Applications.
  + Strong business acumen, with deep expertise in process improvement, negotiation, go-to-market strategies, financial management, data and analytics, driving transformation, and strategic change.
  + Ability to work cross-functionally across a matrixed organization.
  + Ability to quickly summarize and communicate complex information to multiple audiences.
  + Highly effective interpersonal skills, bringing your authentic self to work, building trust and credibility with others.
  + Ready for travel up to 50% (e.g., customer meetings, events, training, etc.).
  + Demonstrates a clear ability to interact and influence management and contributors at all levels of the organization.
  + Excellent communication and collaboration skills; ability to communicate and influence effectively with peers, direct reports, and other teams.
  + Experience implementing PSA is a plus.

  

* Comprehensive health coverage: medical, dental, and vision
* Flexible time off
* Thrive Flex Lifestyle Account (LSA) that allows you to contribute towards your health, financial or learning interests
* 401k w/ match & BrightPlan - to help you save for the future
* Parental Leave
* 5 charitable days to support the community that supports us
* Telemedicine
* Wellness
  + Headspace Care (mental health)
  + Wellbeats (virtual fitness classes)
* RethinkCare & Wellthy– caregiver support
* Diversity and inclusion programs which provide access to internal employee resource groups
* Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
* We Foster a learning culture with:
  + Education Assistance Program
  + Professional development opportunities
  + LinkedIn Learning

Title: Sr Director, Platform Services
Description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

Building trusted markets — powered by our people

  
  

At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.

  
  

We’re building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we’ve earned as a global market leader. Our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.

  
  

To support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model.

  
  

**Location Overview**

Cboe’s New York office is located in the heart of one of the world's most dynamic financial districts, offering employees an exciting, fast-paced environment at the forefront of global trading and finance. Situated in Manhattan, our office provides easy access to Wall Street, major financial institutions, and a network of innovative fintech companies. With a central location, Associates can enjoy excellent transportation options, as well as the vibrant culture, dining, and entertainment that New York City is known for.

Our office fosters a collaborative atmosphere with a high-energy vibe, giving employees the best of both worlds: the close-knit camaraderie of a focused team and the expansive opportunities of a global organization.

  

**Role Overview**

Cboe’s platform teams run the technology that the BIDS, Clearing and FX businesses depend on, and the Sr Director, Platform Services leads the organization that operates it. You will own the platform service offering for each business unit, treat its engineering teams as your customers and be accountable for how reliably it runs.

You will choose the platform products, service tiers and topologies each business receives from the configurations Platform Engineering supports, then deliver and operate them across Kubernetes, managed databases, Kafka, Linux, DevOps infrastructure and hardware. This is a chance to build a customer-focused, SRE-driven operating model for mission-critical market infrastructure, with real influence over how Cboe’s engineering teams ship.

Your responsibilities will be:

* Own the platform service portfolio and roadmap for each business unit, with application engineering teams as your direct customers: intake, service reviews, capacity planning and feedback. Act as Platform Engineering’s primary customer, bringing in business-unit requirements and escalating needs the supported catalog cannot meet.

* Choose the platform products, service tiers and topologies each business unit receives from the configurations Platform Engineering supports, and record the reasons behind each choice.

* Publish and commit to service levels, objectives and indicators for each business unit, and give consumers advance notice of material platform change.

* Operate the Kubernetes, managed database and Kafka platforms, along with Linux fleets, server and storage hardware, and CI/CD infrastructure (such as GitHub Enterprise, Jenkins, Harbor and GitOps controllers), including lifecycle, patching and provisioning against application team declarations.

* Lead Site Reliability for the platform: SLOs, error budgets, platform on-call, incident leadership within the platform and joint post-incident reviews with application teams.

* Partner with Information Security, Risk, Compliance and Internal Audit on control and regulatory obligations (such as Reg SCI and SOC), including audit evidence and break-glass custody.

* Lead and develop a team of engineers, and manage vendors and capacity planning.

The ideal candidate has

* 12+ years of technology experience, including 5+ years leading large infrastructure, SRE or platform operations organizations, ideally including leaders of leaders.

* A proven record delivering and operating mission-critical, high-availability platforms for internal engineering customers in financial services, capital markets or a comparable regulated environment.

* Experience running platform services as a product: service catalogs, tiering, published service levels and customer engagement.

* Deep knowledge of Kubernetes and cloud-native operations, plus Linux fleet operations, Kafka, managed databases and CI/CD and GitOps infrastructure, with strong SRE practice (SLOs, error budgets, incident command and post-incident review).

* Strong stakeholder skills, including managing a supplier and customer relationship with an internal engineering organization, plus experience with budgeting, vendor management and talent development.

* Preferred: experience with trading, clearing or FX systems and Reg SCI or SOC control environments; hybrid cloud and on-prem, multi-region and hardware lifecycle experience.

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or a related field (advanced degree a plus).

Benefits and Perks

We value the total wellbeing of our people – including health, financial, personal and social wellness. We believe standard benefits like health insurance and fair pay are given at any organization. Still, you should know what we offer:

* Medical Coverage

* Prescription Drug Coverage

* Additional Medical Benefit

* Dental Coverage

* Vision Coverage

* 401K or Pension Company Match

* Spending Accounts

* Life and AD&D Insurance

* Retirement Savings Plan

* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

* Voluntary & Additional Benefits

* Paid Time Off

  

**More About Cboe Global Markets**

We’re reimagining the future of the workplace by focusing on what matters most, our people. Our journey is an inclusive one. We’re investing deeply in leadership programs and career development initiatives that ensure everyone has an equal chance to succeed.

  
  

We work with purpose, solving problems with ingenuity, collaboration, and a lot of passion. We’re an engaged and excited team connecting markets across borders and embracing growth in all its forms to achieve incredible outcomes.

  
  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment based on any legally protected characteristic, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status. We are committed to fostering a workplace where all individuals are valued and respected.

  
  

**This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.**

  

**Salary Ranges (applicable for US locations only)**

At Cboe, we are committed to providing a competitive, transparent, and market‑informed total rewards program. The anticipated base salary range for this role is $276,250-$357,500, with actual compensation determined by job‑related factors such as skills, relevant experience, education, internal alignment, and location.  

This role may also be eligible for annual incentive compensation and, where applicable, participation in Cboe's long-term equity programs.

Additional information about Cboe's total rewards program, including benefits and other compensation components, can be found here: Total Rewards at CBOE.

  

*Any communication directly from Cboe regarding this position will come from a Cboe recruiter who has an @cboe.com email address or via LinkedIn Recruiter. Cboe also partners with a select group of trusted recruiting and staffing agencies to support our hiring efforts, so you may also be contacted by an external recruiter working on our behalf. We recognize the importance of protecting candidates from fraudulent recruiting activity. If you are ever uncertain whether an individual or agency is an authorized Cboe recruiting partner, please contact CboeHR@cboe.com, and our team can help verify the outreach.*

Title: Senior Technical Program Manager – RF Engineering

AST SpaceMobile and our global partners are building the first and only space-based cellular broadband network to be accessible by standard smartphones. Called SpaceMobile, this ultra-powerful network is being designed to provide connectivity at 4G/5G speeds everywhere on the planet – on land, at sea and in flight.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager – RF Engineering to lead complex, cross-functional engineering programs supporting advanced wireless communications and aerospace systems. This role is responsible for driving program execution across multiple RF hardware and systems development initiatives, coordinating engineering, manufacturing, testing, and external partners to ensure successful delivery. The ideal candidate combines strong technical program management expertise with a solid understanding of RF systems, satellite communications, or other highly technical hardware development environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end execution of multiple RF engineering programs from development through deployment and operational readiness.
* Manage integrated schedules, budgets, resource planning, and program deliverables across multiple engineering workstreams.

Title: Lead System Administrator
Description:
**About Us**

UMO is a stealth-mode FinTech venture aiming to evolve the way people experience money by building a unified, AI-powered, yet deeply human money platform across fiat, crypto, and investments – subject to regulatory approvals. The platform is being designed to break down traditional barriers to money across access, assets, and experience, enabling simpler, more adaptive ways for people to interact with financial services.

We are currently developing our MVP and navigating licensing requirements, with a multidisciplinary team of 100+ people representing 20+ nationalities. With our headquarters in the UAE, we are united behind a shared ambition and a relentless focus on serving our customers.

**About this role**

You will own internal IT end to end — identity and access, SaaS services, workstations and the corporate network that every colleague relies on daily. You'll lead a team of five administrators and take charge of the subscription budget, quarterly planning and renewals. We give you real decision-making authority: only spend above the limit, headcount or key vendor changes, risk acceptance and company-wide changes go up for approval. Everything else is your call, within the boundaries set out under "Decision Rights".

**You'll take ownership of:**

This is a hands-on lead role. Roughly 30% of your time goes to people, planning and alignment, and 70% to hands-on work: complex changes, incident investigation, configuration reviews, automation. You set up routine work so that it runs without you.

**1. Team and quarterly planning**

* Lead five administrators: 1:1s, goals, feedback. Run hiring for approved positions and, when necessary, parting ways — the latter agreed with your manager.
* Organize work across time zones: open incidents are handed over in writing to a specific person, and inconvenient hours are shared fairly. Three time zones cover about 13 hours of the working day, but not 24/7: you decide what truly requires a night-time or weekend response.
* Every critical system has a primary administrator and a backup who knows how to restore it.
* Each quarter, bring a plan: goals, owners, a support buffer and a list of what did not make the cut. Base it on feedback from engineers, recurring incidents and the renewal calendar. At the end of the quarter, show what was done, what was not and why. If urgent work comes up mid-quarter, say what moves and at what cost.
* Prepare a monthly report for the area: service and support health, access status, subscription spend and optimization results, key risks and items that need a management decision.

**2. Identity and access reviews**

* The identity provider is the central point of access provisioning: SSO, phishing-resistant MFA, role-based groups, SCIM. Hiring, transfers and terminations are triggered from the HR system.
* You verify revocation in the application itself. Deactivating a user in the identity provider does not end active sessions or revoke API tokens, local accounts and guest access. Systems without SCIM have an owner for manual revocation, and you make sure it is done.
* Access review frequency depends on risk: privileged and financial systems quarterly, everything else every six months. The system owner decides on each access, revocation is confirmed in the target system, and every exception has a reason and an expiry date. Results are retained as audit evidence.

**3. Corporate services and developer support**

* **Zero Trust access and DNS:**
  Zero Trust for internal tools (access policies, secure web gateway, device posture) and DNS for corporate domains. Policy changes roll out to a limited group first, and the on-call engineer has a rollback procedure. WAF and the product perimeter stay with DevOps.
* **Cloud, corporate side:**
  Cloud SSO integrated with the identity provider, role assignments agreed with DevOps, sandbox accounts, spend in corporate accounts. Organization structure and production belong to DevOps.
* **Corporate messaging:**
  Apps and integrations, guests and external channels, retention policies. Before a bot is installed, you know what data it reads and who owns it.
* **Collaboration suite:**
  Mail, calendar and documents: sharing rules, third-party OAuth apps, SPF, DKIM and DMARC, data transfer at offboarding.
* **Ticketing and knowledge base:**
  Permissions, projects and spaces, SSO sign-in. The ticketing system is the team's work queue, the knowledge base holds documentation.
* **Workstations:**
  MDM: encryption, updates, security policies, shipping a laptop to another country with zero-touch setup.
* Build self-service for developers: standard access is requested via chat or a ticket, approved by the resource owner and granted automatically for a limited time.
* Set support priorities: major outages and security incidents first, then requests that block teams from working.
* Together with DevOps, define clear ownership boundaries and drive shared requests to resolution: a ticket is closed when the problem is solved for the user, not when it has been handed to another team.

**4. Subscriptions and costs**

* Maintain the SaaS registry: owner, cost, number of seats, actual usage, renewal date and the last day the order can still be changed.
* Review paid seats separately from access reviews. Once a month, reconcile paid seats against activity. Long inactivity is a reason to check with the owner, not to reclaim the seat automatically: there are break-glass accounts and tools that are only needed once a quarter.
* Plan each contract review backwards from the last day the order can be changed or the renewal cancelled. By that day, the volume is agreed, the negotiation position is ready and the vendor has been notified if required. Example: 80 editor seats are paid for, 30 are actively used — we go to the vendor with 35 and a question about the pricing tier.
* Find shadow IT through OAuth grants and corporate card spend. In corporate cloud accounts, analyze bill growth by account and service together with the resource owner. Measure savings against invoices, separating realized savings from those expected at the next renewal.

**5. AI and automation**

For you, AI is the normal way the whole team works. What we expect:

* First-line support in chat: answers from the knowledge base with source links, request classification and ticket creation, handing unclear cases to a human.
* Preparation of access reviews and license reviews: AI reconciles exports from the identity provider, the HR system and applications and produces a list of anomalies for an administrator to verify.
* Measure the impact: compare time before and after rollout, including the time spent reviewing and correcting errors.
* Set the rules: what data may be shared with a model and where only a human makes the decision. AI does not grant privileged access or reset MFA: an administrator does that, verifying the employee's identity before any MFA reset.
* The whole team knows how to use these tools, not just you.

**About you:**

* **Leadership:**
  2+ years of directly managing system administrators or IT engineers, including a distributed team. You have hired, given difficult feedback and changed priorities mid-quarter in a way the team understood.
* **Okta, in depth:**
  SSO, SCIM, lifecycle management, MFA policies, Workflows. You have implemented it or significantly restructured it, not just created users.
* **Cloudflare, AWS, Slack, at a working level:**
  Cloudflare Zero Trust and DNS; AWS IAM, IAM Identity Center, billing and Cost Explorer; Slack administration: apps, guests, Slack Connect. For each, you can walk us through a change you made yourself: how you tested it and what you did when something broke. Kubernetes, CI/CD and product networking are not required.
* **Google Workspace, Atlassian Cloud, Kandji:**
  Administration of Google Workspace (sharing, OAuth apps, SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and Atlassian Cloud (Jira, Confluence: permissions, projects, Okta sign-in). Kandji or another MDM for macOS.
* **AI, advanced level:**
  You have built an LLM-based automation that your colleagues actually used. In the interview, you will show what was built, how you evaluated errors, where you kept a human in the loop and how much time it saves. "I write prompts in ChatGPT" is not what this role needs.
* **Scripting and APIs:**
  Confident in Python or similar, and able to review other people's code.
* **Access and audit:**
  You have taken access reviews through to actual revocation and answered auditors' questions.
* **Money:**
  You have managed SaaS renewals and can name the amount you saved and explain where it came from.
* **Communication:**
  Fluent English for vendors, documentation and the team.

**Can get you a few bonus points**

* Fintech or another regulated industry; PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001.
* Terraform for Okta, Cloudflare and AWS.
* Okta Identity Governance or similar, SaaS management platforms.

**The UMO Standard**

* **Dynamic Work Environment:**
  Vibrant offices and strong local teams across Lisbon, Dubai, Kyiv, and Lviv — with openness to remote for the right fit.
* **Rest & Recovery:**
  24 days of annual leave, dedicated paid sick leave, and observance of Public Holidays to keep you at your best.
* **Recharge Week:**
  After your first year with us, enjoy two consecutive 4-day work weeks annually — a built-in reset to help you sustain peak performance for the long run.
* **Full Setup:**
  Top-of-the-line hardware and a home office stipend so you can do your best work anywhere.
* **Growth Ecosystem:**
  A dedicated learning budget and room to grow as the company grows.
* **Impact & Ownership:**
  Your work directly shapes the product and company direction — not just executes it.

Title: Area Security Manager, Amazon Corporate Security
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Corporate Security is looking for an experienced, self-motivated, corporate security leader who embodies Amazon’s Leadership Principles, in particular, Customer Obsession, Ownership, Earn Trust, and Bias for Action, to join the team as an Area Security Manager for the Mid-Atlantic and Mid-West region.
  
  
The Area Security Manager reports to a Regional Security Manager, who leads a team of security experts. The Area Security Manager is responsible for implementation of all elements of the Corporate Security program at all Amazon corporate locations in their area of responsibility. The Area Security Manager supports the Regional Security Manager with delivery and oversight of the day-to-day security operations at multiple sites across multiple locations in a highly ambiguous and dynamically fluid environment. The Area Security Manager conducts security assessments, ensures that the corporate sites meet or exceed all requisite security standards, and manages incidents and supporting crisis response. Finally, the Area Security Manager provides security consultancy to local business leadership, develops plans to mitigate gaps in security controls, and manages the guarding and access control programs.  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Deliver best-in-class security services focused on enhancing the safety and security of all Amazon employees, contractors, and visitors.
  
  
Manage day-to-day security operations for a diverse portfolio of sites and customers with unique requirements.
  
  
Manage a team of security personnel.  
  
Implement and improve security plans, policies, and programs.
  
  
Coordinate security incident response.
  
  
Respond to customer security concerns.
  
  
Monitor the external threat environments in the defined area and take measures to minimize security risk to the business to the dynamic security environment.
  
  
Successfully align ACS metrics, goals, and strategic direction across the geographic area to support the overall team and organizational mission.
  
Earn trust through key customer and stakeholder engagements, and liaison with external partners.
  
  
Be the trusted security advisor and subject matter expert in the assigned area of responsibility, through high quality communication and excellent briefing skills.
  
  
Communicate accurately and in a timely manner with stakeholders at the tactical and strategic level.
  
  
Build and maintain close relationships with peers at other security functions at Amazon to exchange and share security concerns and collaborate on closing gaps and building best practices.
  
  
A day in the life  
Oversee guarding operations and hold guarding vendors accountable for the quality-of-service delivery. This includes identifying opportunities for cost efficiencies and frugality.
  
  
Build relationships through coordination with internal and external security partners including local law enforcement.
  
  
Develop and monitor performance metrics to track and improve individual, team, system, and site performance. Implement effective, predictable, and measurable processes and procedures to be communicated clearly among Amazon stakeholders.
  
  
Develop and deliver plans, based on risk assessments, to close any potential gaps in security controls.
  
  
Conduct site security assessments and identify trends in findings and develop and implement measures to address systemic issues.
  
Plan and lead drills, tabletop exercises, and other security readiness activities across sites.
  
  
Manage cross-functional projects and operations. Drive team(s)/partners to meet program and/or product goals.
  
  
Conduct initial incident investigations, triage incidents and collaborate with specialist security teams to support the customer.
  
  
Coordinate corporate security support to events.
  
  
Support the maintenance and testing of business continuity plans.
  
Conduct customer outreach and support organizational safety and security initiatives.
  
  
Monitor physical security device installation, commissioning checks of new buildings; and ongoing maintenance activities, including engagement with vendors.  
  
  
  
About the team  
The Amazon Corporate Security team drives security operations for Protective Services at corporate sites worldwide. Divided in three regions (Americas; Asia Pacific; and Europe, Middle East, and Africa), Amazon Corporate Security is a team of security experts who work closely together to protect and secure Amazon’s people and business.  
  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why Amazon Security?  
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.  
  
Training & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Title: IT Engineering Manager — Endpoint, SaaS
Industry: Software Development and IT Services and IT Consulting
Description:
**A Little Bit About Talabat**
talabat is the leading online food and groceries ordering platform in MENA, operating in 9 countries
  
  
across the region. Founded in 2004 by a small group of entrepreneurs in Kuwait, talabat’s success
  
  
expanded to the rest of the GCC region, Egypt & Jordan, making it the largest and most popular food
  
  
ordering app. With over 2,000+ employees and millions of users, we deliver hundreds of thousands
  
  
of orders every day.We are part of the Delivery Hero network building the next generation of online delivery platforms across the globe. Our network is truly international with engineering teams in 13 countries and
  
  
operations in 40+ countries.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
We are hiring a hands-on IT Engineering Manager to own the Enterprise Applications domain — the devices, collaboration tools, and identity/access that talabat employees rely on every day — and to lead the small engineering team behind it, coordinating across our markets.
  
  
This is a working manager role: roughly 70–80% technical execution and standard-setting, and 20–30% people and delivery leadership. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, staying close to the work while building the automation, documentation, and standards that let the function scale consistently across markets. It is a build role — you set the technical bar by doing, then make that excellence repeatable so it outlives any one person.
  
  
Your domain sits alongside other IT engineering domains, and your success depends as much on clean collaboration across those boundaries as on the depth of your own work. You will define and defend clear ownership of your systems while partnering openly with adjacent teams who depend on them. You will cultivate strong vendor relationships and drive strategic partnerships that enhance application functionality and support — a single quote is a starting point, not a decision.
  
  
Scope boundary: This role owns corporate and employee-facing IT (the digital workplace), including identity and endpoint end-to-end, which adjacent IT teams consume. It does not own product, ordering, or operational (rider/vendor-facing) systems, which sit with separate engineering functions. Where core platforms are provided centrally by Delivery Hero, this role owns the local instances and acts as talabat's engineering interface to those central teams.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
Endpoint & Device Management
  
  
Own endpoint fleet strategy across macOS and Windows — MDM (Jamf, Intune, Jump Cloud), security baselines, patching, encryption, inventory, and the full device lifecycle from procurement and provisioning through to offboarding and asset recovery. Maintain endpoint posture in partnership with Security.
  
  
SaaS Administration
  
  
Own day-to-day administration of the core SaaS stack — Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and similar — including configuration, license management, integrations, cost optimization, and strategic licensing negotiations with vendors. Evaluate and onboard new business tools, retire redundant ones, and operate the local instances of centrally provided platforms. Drive Power User Community deployment and management across entities where applicable.
  
  
Identity & Access
  
  
Administer SSO, MFA, and identity providers (Okta, Entra, Google or similar), operating local instances and interfacing with the central identity platform. Own the Joiner-Mover-Leaver lifecycle — provisioning, deprovisioning, role-based access, least-privilege, and periodic access reviews — automated wherever possible.
  
  
Automation & AI (a core expectation, not a future investment)
  
  
Engineer away repetitive work: if a task is done the same way more than twice, automate it. Scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell) and AI tooling are current expectations of this role. Use automation and AI to create team capacity without growing headcount, and lead the team's adoption of these tools.
  
  
Incident Response & Reliability
  
  
Own incident response and the on-call rotation for your domain. Act as escalation point during peak and out-of-hours periods, run proactive incident communication, and drive root-cause resolution rather than recurring workarounds. Participate in cross-domain incident coordination where issues span into adjacent IT teams. Build reliability and security in by design — every system has a clear answer to "what happens when this fails?"
  
  
Service, Compliance & Standards
  
  
Define and track IT service standards, SLAs, and operational metrics, and run ticketing/ITSM workflows that reduce friction for employees. Ensure a consistent support model across locations and time zones, adhering to agreed service levels. Champion change management practices to ensure seamless application delivery and effective transitions. Contribute to compliance and audit readiness (e.g. SOC 2 / ISO 27001 IT controls, access reviews, evidence) in partnership with Security and central teams. Standardize before scaling — build solutions that work across all markets on a shared foundation, allowing local flavor without fragmenting the stack.
  
  
Leadership, People & Vendors
  
  
Lead, coach, and raise the technical bar of a small IT engineering team, with a mandate to grow both its capability and its headcount. Set the standard hands-on, develop your engineers, and manage performance fairly and decisively — investing genuinely in growth, and making the hard call when the bar cannot be met. Provide mentorship to team members, promote knowledge sharing and professional growth. Create and maintain runbooks, training materials, and self-service resources so knowledge is never trapped in one person's head. Manage vendors, procurement, and renewals — actively challenge cost and drive strategic partnerships rather than transactional relationships.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**What You'll Bring**

* 5–7+ years in IT operations, IT engineering, or corporate IT, with hands-on depth across endpoint, SaaS, and identity — including organisations with 5,000+ users.
* Hands-on expertise with MDM (Jamf / Intune / jumpcloud), identity providers (Okta / Entra), and SaaS administration (Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian).
* Demonstrated scripting and automation ability, and daily use of AI tooling in real work — with concrete examples of what you have built or adopted.
* Proven expertise in business process analysis, requirements gathering, solution design, and vendor management — including cost-effective licensing negotiation.
* A track record of leading or mentoring a small team and raising its operating standard. People-leadership appetite is required; formal management experience is welcome.
* Strong project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex projects on time and within budget across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Proven ability to operate autonomously with limited managerial oversight — self-directed on priorities, delivery, and standard-setting.
* A track record of defining and defending clear domain ownership while collaborating openly with adjacent teams.
* A strong customer-focus mindset toward employees — you treat how IT feels to use as the measure of success, speak in plain language, and never say no to the person without offering an alternative.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships and influence without authority across teams and senior stakeholders.
* A documentation-first working style and comfort operating where a central platform team owns core systems and you own the local layer and the interface.
* Deep understanding of enterprise application security best practices.

Title: Lead Power Systems Engineer - Data Centres
Description:
The Lead Power Systems Engineer is responsible for leading the electrical power systems engineering scope of Digital EPC projects from concept and detailed design through procurement, construction, testing, commissioning and final handover. The role ensures that utility interfaces, substations, medium- and low-voltage distribution, standby generation, UPS systems, energy storage, protection, grounding and power-quality solutions are safe, reliable, resilient and fully aligned with the operational requirements of mission-critical digital infrastructure.

The position provides discipline leadership for data centres, ICT facilities, telecommunications hubs, command-and-control environments, smart infrastructure and other technology-intensive developments. The Lead Power Systems Engineer coordinates engineers, designers, specialist consultants, OEMs, vendors, construction teams, systems integrators and client representatives while managing interfaces with mechanical, structural, ICT, ELV, controls and commissioning functions.

The role safeguards engineering quality and power-system resilience through disciplined design governance, technical studies, equipment specification, protection coordination, redundancy analysis, vendor review and change control. It resolves complex engineering issues and ensures that electrical systems support phased energization, integrated systems testing, reliability objectives and operational handover.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Power Systems Engineering Leadership**

Lead planning, execution and technical assurance of the power systems scope, establishing design priorities, deliverable schedules, resource requirements and quality expectations.

**2. Electrical Architecture & Resilience Design**

Direct development of utility intake, substation, MV/LV distribution, standby generation, UPS, energy-storage and redundant power architectures aligned with availability and operational requirements.

**3. Power System Studies & Protection Coordination**

Oversee load flow, short-circuit, protection coordination, arc-flash, harmonic, grounding, motor-starting and reliability studies and ensure findings are incorporated into the design.

**4. Equipment Specification & Procurement Engineering**

Prepare and review specifications, datasheets, requisitions, technical bid evaluations and vendor documents for transformers, switchgear, generators, UPS, batteries, busways, panels and related equipment.

**5. Multidiscipline & Digital Systems Interfaces**

Manage interfaces with mechanical cooling, ICT, ELV, controls, BMS, DCIM, civil, structural, architectural, construction and commissioning disciplines.

**6. Energy Efficiency, Power Quality & Capacity Planning**

Optimize system capacity, efficiency, power factor, harmonic performance, energy monitoring and future expansion without compromising resilience or maintainability.

**7. Constructability & Site Engineering Support**

Lead constructability reviews and resolve technical queries, field changes, nonconformities, installation issues and energization constraints while protecting design intent.

**8. Engineering Quality, Safety & Compliance**

Ensure calculations, drawings and specifications are checked, verified and approved under quality procedures, authority requirements, electrical codes and contractual obligations.

**9. Testing, Energization & Commissioning Support**

Lead technical readiness for factory and site testing, protection testing, energization, integrated systems testing, failure-mode demonstrations, defect closure and handover.

**10. Team Development & Technical Coordination**

Guide power systems engineers and designers, allocate work, review performance, share technical knowledge and maintain effective stakeholder communication.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE**

**Power Systems Engineering Experience: Minimum 12+ years in design and project delivery**

Progressive experience in electrical power systems for data centres, ICT facilities, telecommunications, mission-critical infrastructure, utilities or technology-intensive EPC projects.

**Discipline Leadership Experience: Minimum 5+ years leading electrical or power systems teams**

Responsibility for architecture, studies, equipment packages, design reviews, vendor coordination, multidisciplinary interfaces and engineering quality.

**Critical Power & Commissioning Experience: Minimum 5+ years across procurement, construction and testing**

Experience translating resilience requirements into equipment, installation, protection, energization, integrated testing and operational-handover solutions.

**KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS**

**1. Critical Power Architecture**

Advanced knowledge of utility supplies, substations, MV/LV distribution, generators, UPS, batteries, transfer systems and redundancy configurations for digital infrastructure.

**2. Power System Analysis & Protection**

Strong command of load flow, short-circuit, protection coordination, arc-flash, harmonic, grounding and reliability studies under relevant international standards.

**3. Electrical Equipment & Vendor Management**

Ability to define requirements, evaluate bids, review vendor designs, manage deviations and coordinate manufacture, inspection, testing and delivery of critical equipment.

**4. Digital Infrastructure & Systems Integration**

Ability to integrate electrical systems with cooling, ICT, BMS, DCIM, controls, metering, security and operational monitoring platforms.

**5. Technical Leadership & Problem Solving**

Strong analytical, communication and decision-making capability to resolve complex power-system issues and align multidisciplinary stakeholders.

**EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS**

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a closely related Engineering discipline

• Professional Engineering registration, chartered status, or equivalent professional qualification preferred

• Master's degree in Electrical Power Systems, Energy, or a related Engineering field advantageous

• Relevant certification or advanced training in data-centre power, protection, power quality, energy management, or project management advantageous

• Training in applicable international electrical codes, power-system analysis software, HSE, or quality management preferred

**TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES**

**Power System Architecture & Distribution:**

Designs and reviews utility intake, substations, MV/LV networks, transformers, switchgear, generators, UPS, batteries, busways and resilient distribution systems.

**Power System Studies & Protection:**

Performs and reviews load flow, short-circuit, discrimination, arc-flash, harmonic, grounding, motor-starting and reliability studies.

**Critical Power & Redundancy Engineering:**

Develops and verifies redundancy, maintainability, failure-mode, capacity and availability strategies for mission-critical digital infrastructure.

**Equipment, Construction & Energization Engineering:**

Controls vendor documentation and resolves installation, testing, protection, nonconformance, field-change and energization matters.

**Digital Power Monitoring & Technical Documentation:**

Integrates metering, power monitoring, BMS and DCIM requirements and uses engineering-data and document-control systems to maintain approved deliverables.

Title: MANAGER, CUSTOMER TECHNOLOGY IMPLEMENTATIONS
Description:
**WHO WE ARE**

GreenShield is a proudly Canadian, national non-profit health care and insurance organization, driven by our mission of Better Health for All. We believe health care is a right, not a privilege, and we are committed to improving health outcomes, advancing health equity, and building a future where every Canadian can reach their full health and well-being potential.

Through our unique integrated payer-provider ("payvider") model, we offer insurance, administer benefits, and pay claims as a ‘payer’ while offering health care services such as mental health, pharmacy, telemedicine, and chronic disease management as a ‘provider’. As a non-profit social enterprise without shareholders, we reinvest our excess earnings to directly support underserved communities. Through GreenShield Cares, we positively impacted the health and well-being of over one million Canadians between 2020 and 2025. What’s driving us now is the commitment to measurably impact an additional three million Canadians by 2030 – across mental health, essential medicines, and chronic disease management – through scalable initiatives that deliver meaningful change in pursuit of our mission of Better Health for All.  
  
At GreenShield, our culture is where purpose meets passion and performance. Our teams work as one to deliver meaningful, measurable impact for the people and communities we serve.

**THE ROLE IN A NUTSHELL**

GreenShield is seeking a customer-focused and experienced Manager, Customer Technology Implementations to lead the delivery of customer-facing technology implementations across the organization.

Reporting to the Director, Technology Project Management Office, this role will oversee a team of technology project managers responsible for coordinating complex implementations for new and existing customers and partners. The portfolio will include implementations supporting GreenShield’s Third Party Administration business, white-labelled GS+ solutions, new customer onboarding, Single Sign-On integrations, API integrations, customer migrations, and other technology-enabled partner solutions.

The Manager will provide clear leadership and accountability across the full implementation lifecycle, from early intake, discovery, requirements definition, and planning through build, testing, launch, stabilization, and transition to operations. Title: Deals, Delivering Deal Value, Manager
Description:
A career within Delivering Deal Value (DDV) will provide you with the opportunity to help clients achieve maximum value on their deal transactions by solving transformational and other complex challenges. We focus on all operational aspects of a transaction – pre- and post-close – including pre-deal and functional due diligence, enterprise-wide integrations, and complex divestitures, carve-outs and separations. Our work spans across a wide range of functional and cross-functional areas, within diverse sectors and industries. As a DDV Manager, you will join a dynamic team of problem solvers dedicated to helping clients navigate complex business challenges — from strategy through execution. You will play a key role in driving value across the full deal lifecycle, partnering with other competencies within PwC’s Deals line of business in order to serve clients in delivering measurable results in high-stakes transactions.

**The Opportunity:**

Our team assists Corporate, Private Equity and Pension Fund clients in their acquisition, integration, and divestiture activity. This team supports clients in all operational aspects of a deal, pre- and post-completion, including:

* Buy- and sell-side functional due diligence (i.e. Operations, HR, Tech, Cyber, etc.)

* Carve-out and separation planning and execution, including standalone cost analysis
* Synergy identification, planning, tracking and execution

Title: Locating Operations Manager
Description:
**Company / division** Danella Line Services, Inc.

**Location** Delaware, field-based (service area: Delaware and Maryland's Eastern Shore, Cecil and Harford counties)

**Employment type** Full-time, on-site/field

**Reports to** Regional Manager, Delaware

**About the Role**
==================

At Danella, we believe in developing and retaining the best people and providing the best value services to our customers. We take pride in everything we do to maintain the nation's infrastructure by connecting people and resources.

Danella is hiring a Locating Operations Manager for our Locating Division, based in Delaware. Our locators mark underground electric, gas, fiber and telecom facilities for utility and cooperative customers across Delaware and Maryland. This position runs day-to-day locating operations so that every 811 ticket is completed safely, on time and profitably.

The Locating Operations Manager works directly with the Regional Manager, a team of locate supervisors, the field workforce, and our accounting and payroll staff. You will be responsible to manage the daily numbers: tickets completed, production per locator, overtime, timesheets, idle time, ticket deadlines and billing data. This role suits a hands-on leader who is able to hold supervisors accountable and develop teams.

**Responsibilities**
====================

The Locating Operations Manager is responsible for meeting our customers' on-time, quality and safety requirements while controlling labor cost. Strong communication with supervisors, locators, accounting and leadership is essential.

* Lead daily locating operations for 80+ locators and a team of locate supervisors across Delaware and Maryland
* Run a daily operations meeting with supervisors to review the prior day's production, overtime, idle time and open tickets, and assign follow-up
* Set clear production expectations (tickets per locator per day and per hour) and coaching locators who fall short of safety or production
* Monitor ticket boards through the day, rebalance workloads, reassign tickets when locators call out, and route emergency tickets to the closest available locator
* Manage ticket due times and extensions to meet on-time requirements and avoid late-ticket and no-response penalties, including end-of-day board checks on a rotating evening and weekend schedule
* Make daily overtime decisions based on production data: approve overtime where it protects on-time performance, and limit it where it does not
* Review and approve locator timesheets daily, verify hours against vehicle telematics, correct discrepancies, and make sure timesheets are submitted on time
* Maintain the daily roster of who is working, off, called out, in training or on hourly assignments
* Track idle time, late starts and mileage by locator, and follow up on outliers with supervisors
* Prepare weekly and monthly billing data by customer, including ticket counts, billing codes, emergency and after-hours work, and over-footage extra charges, and reconcile ticket-system data with accounting before invoicing
* Know the terms of each customer contract (on-time targets, extra-charge rules, audit, damage and penalty terms) and bring pricing or commercial questions to company leadership
* Review customer KPI reports and penalty notices each month, check them against our own data, and prepare disputes where the data supports one
* Recruit, onboard and train locators and supervisors, including trainee rotations and refresher training
* Promote a safe work environment, including safe vehicle parking and idling practices, highway work zones and required safety sweeps
* All other duties as assigned

  

**Qualifications**
==================

What is required:

* 3+ years of experience in leading underground utility locating or damage prevention programs
* Working knowledge of 811 / One Call processes, ticket due times, extensions and marking standards; experience with Miss Utility tickets in Delaware or Maryland strongly preferred
* Experience managing to production and on-time KPIs on unit-price or production-based contracts
* Experience with a ticket management system
* Comfort working from live data: dashboards, timesheet systems and vehicle telematics with strong Microsoft Excel skills
* Willingness to learn new software, including AI-assisted reporting tools
* Valid driver's license with a clean driving record
* Ability to pass a background screening, physical and drug test
* Strong supervisory, leadership and team management skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including difficult conversations about performance
* Strong organizational skills, with attention to detail and accuracy
* Calm, steady and solutions-focused under pressure
* Highly responsible, accountable and dependable

**Availability**
================

* Full-time, field-based role with daily travel across Delaware and Maryland
* Participation in a rotating evening and weekend on-call schedule for end-of-day ticket board checks and urgent tickets

**Workplace Policy**
====================

Danella maintains a workplace that is completely free of drugs and alcohol, and employees are subject to random drug testing.

**What We Offer You**
=====================

* Paid on-the-job technical and professional training
* Defined career path for future growth
* Competitive wages and great benefits, including a 401(k) plan match

Title: Broker Relationship Manager
Description:
The Broker Relationship Manager will be responsible for developing, managing and strengthening relationships with insurance brokers, intermediaries and distribution partners to drive the promotion and sales of International Private Medical Insurance (IPMI) products offered by Dubai Insurance Company in association with Orange Care Plus.

The role requires a candidate with prior experience working with an insurance company, preferably within broker management, intermediary distribution or health insurance business development, with a strong understanding of the UAE insurance market.

The primary objective is to expand the broker network, generate business opportunities, drive product awareness and achieve IPMI business targets through effective broker engagement and relationship management.

**2. Primary Responsibilities**

1. **Broker Relationship Management**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with insurance brokers, intermediaries and distribution partners across the UAE.
* Identify, onboard and activate new brokers to promote DIC's IPMI products.
* Manage existing broker relationships to ensure consistent business engagement and revenue generation.
* Conduct regular broker visits, meetings and business reviews.

2. **Business Development & Sales**

* Drive the promotion and distribution of IPMI products through the broker network.
* Identify new business opportunities and develop strategies to expand market reach.
* Generate qualified leads, follow up on business opportunities and drive conversions.
* Achieve agreed business development, premium and revenue targets.

3. **Product Promotion & Market Development**

* Develop a strong understanding of DIC's IPMI product offerings, benefits, coverage and positioning.
* Conduct product presentations, broker training sessions and awareness meetings.
* Communicate product features, competitive advantages and market opportunities to brokers.
* Gather market intelligence and competitor insights to support product positioning.

4. **Business Coordination & Conversion**

* Coordinate with DIC's underwriting, operations and business teams to facilitate quotations, underwriting queries and policy issuance.
* Ensure timely follow-up on broker enquiries, quotations and pending proposals.
* Support brokers throughout the sales cycle, from initial enquiry to policy conversion.
* Monitor business pipelines and ensure opportunities are followed through to closure.

**3. Secondary Responsibilities**

* Prepare periodic broker performance reports, sales pipelines and business development updates.
* Monitor broker productivity, conversion ratios and business contribution.
* Identify opportunities to improve broker engagement, retention and business volumes.
* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve broker concerns and operational challenges.
* Ensure that all business activities adhere to applicable UAE insurance regulations and company compliance requirements.
* Participate in industry events, networking activities and insurance market engagements.
* Provide feedback to management on market trends, competitor activities and broker requirements.

**4. Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Insurance, Finance, Marketing or a related discipline.
* Professional insurance qualifications or certifications will be an added advantage.

**5. Experience & Competencies**

**Essential Experience:**

* 4–7 years of experience in the UAE insurance industry.
* Prior experience working with an insurance company, preferably in Broker Relationship Management, Intermediary Sales, Distribution or Business Development.
* Experience managing and developing relationships with insurance brokers and intermediaries.
* Exposure to medical insurance or IPMI products is highly preferred.
* Good understanding of the UAE insurance market and broker distribution channels.

**Key Competencies:**

* Strong broker relationship management and networking skills.
* Business development and sales conversion capabilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Strong understanding of insurance products and distribution channels.
* Ability to independently develop business opportunities and achieve targets.
* Strong follow-up, coordination and stakeholder management skills.

Pay: AED7,000.00 - AED21,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Helping Canadians save, businesses grow, and neighbourhoods thrive! Our purpose is to contribute to the success of our clients through continuous improvement and innovative solutions.

SUMMARY

We are hiring an IT Operations Manager to join our Information Technology team. This role will be a full-time, permanent position working out of either our head office in Oakville, Ontario, or our production facility in Ottawa, Ontario. We are looking for someone who is dedicated to ferocious customer service, treating people right, and being a part of a team. Our team is the heart of everything!

The IT Operations Manager will be dedicated to keeping DRMG’s systems, infrastructure, and end-user services reliable, secure, and available while leading day-to-day IT operations and the service desk team. The IT Operations Manager will lead the Group of Companies IT teams, oversee incident, problem, change, and IT asset management processes, and manage key vendor relationships to continuously elevate service delivery across the organization.

Posting Status: This posting is for an existing vacancy.

* Leading day-to-day IT operations and directly managing the DRMG and Dollco IT and service desk teams to elevate service delivery across the organization.

Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation, and one that is reinventing itself as the AI platform for the energy industry.
  
  
Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.
  
  
**Overview**
Serve as a People Leader in the Global Services (GS) business unit, accountable for the successful delivery of Quorum Pipeline Transaction Management (QPTM) and the broader Pipeline Software Suite for midstream customers. QPTM is Quorum's enterprise-grade pipeline transaction management system, used by pipeline and storage operators to manage nominations, scheduling, capacity rights, imbalances, invoicing and settlement, and regulatory compliance. You will lead the team that implements, upgrades and optimizes it for some of the most recognized names in North American midstream.
  
  
**Why This Role, Why Now: Quorum’s Platform Transformation**
Quorum is in the middle of a major transformation. Our vision is to serve as the operating system for the global energy industry: a unified platform where every domain, from subsurface planning to supply chain execution, is connected through a common data foundation and a governed AI layer. We are investing heavily in bringing AI and analytics into the platform, and expanding through strategic acquisitions such as Streamba, an AI-native supply chain platform, announced in June 2026. As this platform evolution reaches our pipeline solutions, Global Services will be on the front line, helping customers move from systems that simply record transactions to a connected, data-driven platform that helps run their operations. This is a rare chance to shape how that transformation is delivered to our pipeline customers and to build the team and delivery model that makes it repeatable.
  
  
**Who Will Succeed In This Role**
The person who succeeds here will be both tech-savvy and deeply grounded in the oil & gas pipeline industry. You understand how a pipeline business actually runs, from nominations and scheduling to capacity release, imbalance management, contract and rate administration, invoicing, and FERC and NAESB requirements, and you can earn the respect of pipeline operators’ commercial, scheduling, accounting and IT leaders on day one. You are equally comfortable discussing cloud deployment, integration architecture, data quality and how AI and analytics can improve a pipeline workflow. You are a leader who can bridge the two worlds: translating what operators need into how the technology is configured, delivered and adopted.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead successful delivery of QPTM and Pipeline Software Suite implementations, upgrades, cloud migrations and legacy system replacements for natural gas and liquids pipeline and storage customers
* Bring deep pipeline industry knowledge to every engagement, guiding customers on scheduling, capacity, contract, imbalance, invoicing and regulatory (FERC/NAESB) processes and ensuring the solution reflects industry best practice
* Drive repeatability and consistency across pipeline implementations through standard delivery methodologies, accelerators and reusable assets
* Manage and lead a high performing team of 15+ employees, including consultants, project managers and technical resources
* Prepare the team and our customers for Quorum’s platform transformation, building fluency in AI, analytics, data and integration capabilities as they are introduced into the Pipeline Software Suite and the wider Quorum platform
* Partner with Product and Engineering to bring field insight into the roadmap, and help shape how new platform, AI and analytics capabilities are deployed with customers
* Oversee integration of QPTM with adjacent systems such as measurement (including Quorum FLOWCAL), accounting, ETRM and commercial applications to deliver an end-to-end customer solution
* Manage to quarterly customer satisfaction, revenue and project quality goals
* Manage customer satisfaction across implementation projects including managing relationships with customer leadership and acting as a trusted advisor at the executive level
* Coordinate to ensure all staffing needs are addressed, ensuring all resources are appropriately managed and utilized
* Create a positive and rewarding workplace for employees
* Monitor employee engagement and define plans to improve overall engagement and retention
* Support Sales activities, ensuring messaging for services is clearly defined and accurate
* Ensure a high degree of quality for any Services participation in Sales activities
* Effectively contribute to and communicate Company and Services organizational goals and ensure key performance indicator alignment across the business segment
* Drive effective cross-organizational collaboration including Sales, Support, Customer Success, Product and Engineering
* Contribute to a strong team culture in the professional services organization
* And other duties as assigned.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in technology or business
* Deep knowledge of the oil & gas pipeline industry, ideally natural gas transportation and storage, including nominations, scheduling, capacity release, contracts and rates, imbalances, invoicing and settlements, and FERC/NAESB regulatory requirements
* Technology savvy, with a working understanding of cloud/SaaS deployment, system integration, APIs, data and reporting, and a genuine curiosity about how AI and analytics are changing enterprise software
* 8+ years in software implementations, preferably large enterprise solution implementations, ideally with pipeline or midstream transaction management systems
* 5+ years leadership experience managing teams of 10+
* Management of revenue, customer satisfaction and project quality goals
* Ability to utilize MS Office applications including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.
* Experience in customer facing roles at the executive level
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to effectively deliver presentations to all levels of the organization
* The ability to understand business goals and recommend approaches to effect continual improvements
* Strong organizational skills and an ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities/projects
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with peers in a team-oriented environment
* Effective project management and change management skills, including leading customers through major technology and process change
* Strong leadership skills, driving a positive and rewarding culture
* Strong interpersonal skills, capable of driving to solutions across organizations
* Ability to travel up to 25%

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Quorum Pipeline Transaction Management (QPTM) or comparable pipeline transaction management systems
* ETRM (Energy Trading and Risk Management) experience, such as deal capture, scheduling and logistics, risk, or settlements, and an understanding of how it connects to pipeline operations
* Experience with AI, analytics or data platform initiatives, including helping customers adopt and realize value from them
* Experience delivering cloud/SaaS and platform migration programs for energy customers

The successful candidate will be required to ensure they maintain and renew any visas or permits that grant employment eligibility where applicable.

Quorum Software connects people and information across the energy value chain. Twenty years ago, we built the first software for gas plant accountants. At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Silvus Technologies is dedicated to one mission: connecting those who keep us safe.
