Together, our radios and waveform provide vital communications for mission critical applications in the harshest environments from underground tunnels to high altitude balloons.
  
  
Silvus StreamCaster™ radios are being rapidly adopted by customers all over the world ranging from the U.S. and Allied Nations Departments of Defense, to International, Federal, State and Local Law Enforcement agencies, all the way to the Superbowl, Grammys and industry-leading drone, robot, and unmanned systems manufacturers.

**Job Description**
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
Silvus Technologies, the global leader in advanced MIMO mesh networking solutions for defense, industrial, and public safety applications, is seeking a
**Senior Research and Development (R&D) Program Manager**
who will report to the Vice President of Research and Development (R&D).
  
  
This is a foundational role for Silvus R&D that blends technical know-how with strategic thinking and process-oriented execution. This position offers a unique opportunity to shape and deliver key new technology solutions within Silvus’ growing R&D organization. The Program Manager will partner closely with Senior R&D and Engineering leadership, as well as Silvus management, Business Development, and Product teams to define programmatic goals, both technical and strategic, drive cross-functional project execution, and deliver high-impact products to Silvus customers.
  
  
This role is part of a passionate team redefining radio frequency (RF) sensing, electronic warfare and wireless connectivity in the most demanding environments, from battlefield networks and autonomous systems to public safety and industrial applications. You will work alongside world-class engineers solving real-world challenges, with opportunities to grow, innovate, and lead as our organization scales.

**West Los Angeles,**
**CA,**

Title: Project Manager - Program Management (St Louis)
Description:
**Description**

Burns & McDonnell is proud to be the market leader in providing program management services to the electric utility industry. As our clients focus on their capital investment in the energy delivery market, Burns & McDonnell brings a seasoned team to assist them across a variety of operational roles to ensure the needed grid improvements are executed on time and on budget. The ideal candidate will have a safety-first mindset, be dedicated to making their clients and teams successful, and take an entrepreneurial approach to their job. As programs are an extension of our clients day-to-day operations, roles within the program management track allow for frequent, often daily, client interaction. Engineers on the program management track leverage their technical expertise and education to make informed decisions in the execution of projects on behalf of our clients.

Project managers at Burns & McDonnell are a key part of our informal leadership structure. They will be expected to mentor junior staff and lead multi-disciplinary teams in the execution of our most complex projects. In the program management organization, project managers will be relied on to support the overall development of project management capabilities through the functional leadership of day-to-day task execution. Project managers may lead specific functional areas within a larger program or lead the entirety of a smaller program working directly with our clients to provide a premier client experience.

Generally, project managers in program management will pursue job responsibilities in the following areas:

**Project Management**

* Lead a cross-functional team to execute substation, transmission line, and telecommunication projects from inception through design and construction to closeout.
* Oversee 5-20 projects concurrently of varying sizes ($100k-$50M ) and voltages (4kV-765kV).
* Manage projects for schedule adherence identifying risks and requirements to successfully achieve a project’s in-service date.
* Navigate projects through client gate approval processes including presentations to senior and executive management as required by each client.
* Manage projects for financial adherence maintaining an accurate cost forecast reflecting committed and uncommitted costs for an estimate-at-completion.
* Coordinate craft labor resources with client approved vendors for construction, testing and other field activities.
* Provide regular status updates on projects by maintaining project data and routine reporting as well as meeting updates for clients.
* Lead project meetings with cost, schedule, real estate, environmental, construction and engineering resources to facilitate project execution.

**Portfolio Management**

* Develop a multi-year capital expenditure plan to support client’s replacement and betterment of electric transmission and distribution assets.
* Regular interface and coordination with project sponsor organizations to determine details of proposed plans and business justification.
* Ensure synergies across projects are incorporated into the portfolio of work to prevent scope from being duplicated or performed inefficiently.
* Monitor composition of client’s capital investment allocation to align with stated subsidiary investment targets for optimal rate of return.
* Engage with project sponsors to evaluate need-by date for realistic schedules and budgets.
* Assist with creation and compilation of rate filing support for federal and state filings.
* Review tabletop engineering estimates for accuracy and scope.
* Review project change requests (scope, In-service date, etc.) and reconcile with the existing and long-range portfolio of work.
* Interface with client’s accounting group to establish financial setup for projects.
* Create analyses & reports to assist the client in tracking, coordination, and execution of projects.
* Build baseline scopes, schedules, and budgets to be released to multiple client’s stakeholders.

**Outage/Construction Sequencing**

* Responsible for development of substation and transmission project construction lifecycles with focus on outage efficiency and constructability.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting specified deliverable dates and expectations.
* Analyze scoping and project documents to determine boundaries of required construction within substation and within electric grid.
* Conduct site walkdowns and project calls with project team as necessary to establish an achievable construction sequence with attainable outages.
* Analyze needed outages against adjacent outages scheduled in the area.
* Create initial outage sequence to communicate proposed construction lifecycle to project team.
* Coordinate with drafting resources to create engineering-caliber drawings that document the evolution of a project from present conditions to final state, and all needed incremental steps.
* As part of the Burns & McDonnell team we are looking for team members that foster a culture based on our MacCulture Principles, quality, diversity, and inclusion to enhance team cohesion and camaraderie. Individuals who want to tackle new and novel challenges within the utility industry to help our clients improve the execution of capital investment work can find entrepreneurial opportunities to assist in the pursuit and expansion of our program management offerings.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor Degree in engineering, construction management or related degree from accredited program required.
* Minimum of seven years of experience in engineering design, project management or a relevant role required.
* Completion of P.E., PMP, MBA or comparable advanced degree strongly preferred.
* Excellent facilitation, collaboration, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to thoughtfully and positively influence, lead and manage.
* Strong planning and analytical skills.
* E.I.T. or PE license strongly preferred.
* Must demonstrate superb oral and written communication skills, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to clearly and effectively present complex information to all levels of employees, management, and clients.
* Demonstrated success in project management which includes proposal development, contract negotiations, project planning, team leadership, budgeting, schedule management, and client coordination.
* Proven ability to develop business and establish relationships with clients.
* Travel 15-25% depending on project assignment and client needs.

This job posting will remain open a minimum of 72 hours and on an ongoing basis until filled.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role with accountability for infrastructure, cloud, networks, corporate systems, AI applications, IT service management, business continuity and IT audits across all our offices worldwide.

You will lead the Support, Network and Systems Engineering teams and the Jira team, drive IT projects from start to finish, and build the IT foundation for every new office we open. * Lead, mentor and develop the Support Engineering, Network Engineering, Systems Engineering and Jira teams.

* Manage IT projects end to end, from scoping and business case through delivery and review.
* Be responsible for IT in all global offices.
* Lead the IT setup for new offices opened across the globe, including network, devices, access, telephony and local compliance needs.

**Security, Business Continuity & Audits**

* Own Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans, including regular testing.
* Be responsible for global and internal IT audits, including evidence preparation, auditor coordination and closing findings.

**Required Knowledge & Experience**

* At least 10 years of experience in IT, including 5 years in a senior leadership role managing multiple technical teams.
* Proven experience running IT across multiple countries or offices, ideally in financial services, fintech or another regulated industry.
* Track record of setting up new offices from an IT standpoint.
* Strong hands-on experience with:
* Microsoft 365 administration and Azure
* Cloudflare, DNS and domain management
* Enterprise networking (LAN/WAN, VPN, firewalls)
* Private or in-house cloud and server infrastructure
* Telephony platforms
* ITSM tools and frameworks (ITIL or equivalent) and Jira administration
* SSO, identity management and user registration and provisioning flows
* Good understanding of APIs and system integrations.
* Practical security experience across infrastructure, endpoints, access control and data protection.
* Experience designing and testing Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans.
* Experience leading internal and external IT audits, for example ISO 27001, SOC 2 or regulator-driven reviews.
* Familiarity with enterprise AI tools and the governance they require.
* Experience writing and enforcing IT policies and procedures.
* Experience with IT budgeting, vendor negotiation and cost control.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field (Master's preferred).

* Experience in brokerage, trading or exchange environments with high-availability requirements.
* Experience introducing and governing AI tools across an enterprise.
* Exposure to multi-jurisdiction regulatory requirements affecting IT and data.
* Fluency in Arabic or another language relevant to our regions.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work with an industry-leading global financial institution.
* Competitive salary and comprehensive employee benefits.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Collaborative, inclusive, and dynamic work environment.
* Commitment to innovation and professional excellence.

*Become part of our international community at MultiBank Group, dedicated to excellence, innovation, and shaping the future of finance.*

Title: Technical Account Manager - Openshift (Remote, Doha with French)

The **Business Development Manager** is responsible for delivering new business revenue and converting opportunities in these sectors across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Working under the direction of the Chief Growth Officer, the role drives pipeline development, builds and maintains client relationships and leads the sales effort on assigned opportunities and accounts, supporting Serco's positioning as a trusted, high-quality partner in delivering Vision 2030 priorities.

The role works side by side with the Business Development and Advisory teams, combining personal origination and account management with close collaboration on propositions, bids and the client engagement programme. It targets ministries, government entities, PIF-backed organisations, giga-projects and national energy, defence and space players, converting opportunities into sustainable revenue and operational growth.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Sales Delivery and Revenue Growth**

* Accountable for delivering assigned new business revenue and profit targets across the government, energy, defence and space sectors in the KSA, through personal origination, account growth and pipeline conversion.
* Execute the sector sales plan agreed with the Sales Director, covering government services, ministries, PIF and giga-projects, energy (oil and gas, power and utilities, renewables and energy transition), defence and space.
* Build and maintain a qualified, high-quality pipeline that meets short- and long-term growth ambitions, with accurate pipeline data maintained in MS Dynamics.
* Use market analysis and intelligence, shared with the Business Development and Advisory teams, to identify target clients, emerging trends, competitor activity and whitespace aligned to Vision 2030 priorities.
* Track and report on pipeline, forecast and conversion performance, escalating risks to targets to the Sales Director.

**Client Access and Relationship Development**

* Own relationships with assigned clients at senior level across ministries, government agencies, PIF entities, giga-projects and energy, defence and space organisations, escalating strategic and executive-level engagement to the Sales Director.
* Build and sustain a network of clients, partners and key stakeholders across the target sectors.
* Engage clients early in their decision-making cycle to understand requirements and position Serco's solutions.
* Implement the structured Client Engagement Programme and maintain account plans for assigned major customers, in line with the framework set by the Sales Director.
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients, working with the Advisory team to offer insight that leads to repeat business.

**Commercial Support and Negotiation**

* Lead commercial negotiations on assigned opportunities within delegated authority, escalating major or strategic negotiations to the Sales Director and General Manager – KSA.
* Contribute to the structuring of contracts, partnerships and joint ventures, working with Commercial and Finance colleagues to ensure commercial robustness.
* Maintain awareness of pricing, margin performance, risk allocation and contract terms to support profitable, sustainable growth.
* Balance client needs, delivery credibility and commercial outcomes when closing opportunities.

**Propositions and Joint Working**

* Work alongside the Business Development and Advisory teams to shape government, energy, defence and space propositions, bringing client insight and helping validate market need and competitor positioning.
* Contribute to joint propositions and commercial models, including local partnerships and strategic supplier relationships, that showcase end-to-end solutions.
* Support go-to-market activity, including customer segmentation, sales analytics and the packaging of propositions with marketing experts.
* Work with the Advisory team to create an advisory-to-operations pathway that unlocks downstream implementation and long-term contract opportunities.
* Share client feedback and market insight to strengthen Serco's existing unique selling propositions and inform new products and service offerings.

**Bid Support**

* Work closely with the Bidding team to ensure timely, high-quality submissions for all targeted opportunities.
* Lead the sales input to bids on assigned opportunities, ensuring a persuasive, commercially competitive offering that fully reflects customer requirements.
* Guide assigned bids through Serco's internal governance and approval process, with the support of the Bidding team and the Sales Director.
* Understand local laws, public procurement processes and government buying environments in the KSA.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Representation**

* Advocate for Serco externally and internally at a senior level, representing the Sales Director where required.
* Pitch Serco's capabilities and deliver value propositions against client requirements through high-quality presentations and proposals.
* Represent Serco at industry conferences, trade shows and networking events in KSA.
* Work with colleagues to share operational good practice, exploit synergies and promote cross-selling across sectors and business units.

**Team Contribution, Reporting and Compliance**

* Support and guide junior sales and business development colleagues, and contribute to the development of local talent in line with Saudization and capability-building objectives.
* Act as sales sponsor on assigned accounts, working with Operations to ensure quality, client satisfaction and measurable outcomes.
* Maintain accurate records of sales activity and provide regular updates to the Sales Director and senior management.
* Ensure compliance with local laws, regulations and cultural considerations in KSA, and contribute to Serco-wide corporate governance and good practice.

**Specific Requirements**

* 10 to 15 years of relevant experience and an established network across Saudi government, semi government organisations, PIF companies and major infrastructure operators.
* Demonstrable experience working with government entities, ministries, giga-projects, sovereign-backed organisations and/or PIF-related environments.
* Experience in the energy sector (oil and gas, power and utilities, renewables or energy services), with a network among key energy-sector stakeholders.
* Exposure to the defence and space sectors, including engagement with defence and space entities, programmes and partners.
* Proven track record of originating and closing complex opportunities and delivering significant annual revenue in government services, consulting or related sectors.
* Experience contributing to commercial negotiations, including strategic partnerships, JVs and multi-stakeholder opportunities.
* Bidding and commercial experience on large, complex business opportunities.
* Good understanding of the Saudi business and government landscape, Vision 2030 priorities, and national transformation programmes and investment themes.
* Experience navigating public procurement and relationship-led market development.
* Familiarity with PIF ecosystem dynamics, giga-project stakeholder structures and local partnership models.
* Appreciation of localization, Saudization and in-Kingdom value creation expectations, with high cultural awareness.

**Join Us**

At Serco, we believe there is a place here for everyone. A place where you can bring your authentic self to work every day. Our workplace culture is one that embraces diversity and fosters equity, respect, and belonging for every individual. We are committed to equal employment opportunities and creating an inclusive environment that proudly celebrates the perspectives and backgrounds that each of our employees bring to work every day.

Join Serco and be part of a values-driven organization that invests in the development and well-being of its employees and offers a rewarding and fulfilling career.

Serco is committed to Equal Employment Opportunities and is committed to ensuring the safety of all of its employees through its Zero Harm initiative. Please visit **careers.serco.com** for more information.

Title: Senior Vice President (Financial Services)
Description:
The Opportunity  
  
Toronto Financial Services is entering its next phase of growth. Artificial intelligence is changing how clients operate, Global Capability Centres are reshaping delivery models, and market disruption is accelerating. Clients increasingly look to CGI for strategic business outcomes.  
  
CGI is investing in a leader who can accelerate growth, strengthen executive relationships, expand consulting-led engagements, and position CGI as a partner for business and technology transformation.  
  
You will bring together CGI’s capabilities—including Business Consulting, Systems Integration, Managed Services, AI-enabled services, reusable IP, and strategic partnerships—to solve clients’ business challenges and build long-term relationships.  
  
As leader of one of CGI Canada’s largest Financial Services businesses, you will have full accountability for growth, profitability, client relationships, delivery excellence, and leadership development. You will grow the business by connecting clients with the full breadth of CGI’s capabilities.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

What you’ll deliver  
  
Accelerate growth  
Grow organically and win new business across Managed Services, Systems Integration, Business Consulting, and IP—in existing client ecosystems and new markets.  
  
Elevate Business Consulting  
Make Business Consulting a primary driver of transformational engagements. Build consulting-led opportunities that create lasting strategic partnerships and deepen CGI’s influence within client organizations.  
  
Drive profitable growth  
Improve profitability through disciplined portfolio management, innovative commercial models, and operational excellence. Expand higher-value, outcome-based engagements and strengthen contribution margins.  
  
Build AI into the business  
Use AI to improve productivity, delivery, and client outcomes. Develop new revenue opportunities through AI-enabled services.  
  
Build a high-performing culture  
Develop a strong leadership bench and attract exceptional talent. Simplify the operating model to support growth without proportional increases in headcount, while fostering energy, collaboration, and belonging.  
  
Create new demand  
Raise CGI’s profile with clients, alliance partners, and the market through measurable client outcomes, strategic relationships, and thought leadership.  
  
Grow through partnerships  
Work with hyperscaler and technology partners, and pursue client co-innovation, to extend CGI’s reach and create new growth opportunities.  
  
Who you’ll work with  

* Report to the BU Leader, Financial Services.
* Lead Vice Presidents and Directors across Consulting, Delivery, and Client Management.
* Partner with enterprise leaders in Business Consulting, IP and AI, HR, Marketing, and Operations.
* Build strategic relationships with alliance partners and industry leaders.
* Engage directly with C-suite executives across the client base.

  
The operating code  

* Own it: Address problems early with accountability and ownership.
* Move at the speed of the opportunity: Make timely decisions and respond to clients’ needs.
* Bring ideas before they’re asked for: Shape the agenda and anticipate opportunities.
* Make AI non-negotiable: Build AI fluency across the leadership team and the business.
* Protect the standard: Maintain quality, delivery excellence, and client trust.
* Say the hard thing early: Lead with transparency and clarity.
* Prove it with numbers: Measure success through outcomes and business impact.
* Make noise about what works: Recognize success and share practices that can benefit the broader business.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

What you’ve done before:  

* Built or scaled a consulting, technology, or managed services business with full P&L accountability, growing revenue and margin together.
* Driven organic growth and new client acquisition across multiple service lines.
* Led executive-level client relationships and secured large, strategic engagements, including opportunities developed before formal procurement.
* Shifted staff augmentation or time-and-materials engagements to outcome-based commercial models.
* Built leadership teams and succession plans, and raised market visibility through analyst relations, media engagement, and industry recognition.
* Led AI adoption across a leadership team and the business.
* Earned a bachelor’s degree or gained equivalent experience. An MBA is an asset.

  
What success looks likeThree years from now:  

* Revenue growth has outpaced the market.
* Business Consulting represents a larger share of the business.
* AI-enabled services generate meaningful revenue.
* Contribution margins have improved.
* Clients engage CGI earlier and more strategically.
* Leaders have advanced into broader enterprise roles.
* Capabilities developed within the sector are being applied across Toronto Financial Services

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  
  
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  
  
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  
  
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  
  
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

We collaborate with our clients to build more inclusive communities and empower all CGI partners to thrive. That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

Title: Gestionnaire, plateformes technologiques d’ingénierie
Description:
**Job Description**
**Et si vous pouviez redéfinir ce qui est possible? Avec nous, vous le pouvez.**
Avec nous, vous le pouvez. Vous recherchez un travail qui a du sens. Des possibilités de croissance. Des occasions de vous dépasser. Des gens qui vous comprennent.
  
  
Nous sommes le foyer de personnes ambitieuses, passionnées et innovantes qui façonnent le monde de demain.
  
  
Grâce à une expertise inégalée en ingénierie, en services-conseils et en sciences, nos équipes à travers le monde unissent leurs forces pour créer des solutions adaptées aux réalités locales.
  
  
Nous ouvrons la voie et générons un impact.
  
  
Nous sommes des visionnaires.
  
  
Nous sommes WSP.
  
  
**L’opportunité**
Prenez les commandes de la stratégie, de la livraison, de la gouvernance et de l’excellence opérationnelle des plateformes technologiques qui soutiennent les applications d’ingénierie de WSP à l’échelle mondiale. Dans ce rôle de leadership, vous contribuerez à créer des environnements sécuritaires, évolutifs, résilients et rentables couvrant notamment l’hébergement d’applications, les plateformes infonuagiques et hébergées par des fournisseurs, l’infrastructure de bureau virtuel (VDI), la gouvernance des données, l’automatisation et les technologies d’ingénierie de nouvelle génération.
  
  
En collaborant avec les équipes Client Delivery Solutions (CDS), Infrastructure, Sécurité, Architecture, Données et IA ainsi qu’avec les équipes d’ingénierie, vous contribuerez à créer les conditions permettant à nos équipes de projets et à nos professionnels de l’ingénierie de donner le meilleur d’eux-mêmes, tout en préparant WSP aux technologies et aux méthodes de travail de demain.
  
  
**Votre impact**

* Façonner la stratégie et les opérations des plateformes d’ingénierie : Définir et gouverner la stratégie technologique des plateformes soutenant les applications d’ingénierie mondiales. Assurer la préparation opérationnelle, la disponibilité, la performance, la résilience et l’évolutivité des environnements technologiques d’ingénierie. Établir les normes de plateforme, les cadres de gouvernance technique et les procédures d’exploitation des services, tout en dirigeant la planification du cycle de vie et les initiatives de modernisation.
* Faire évoluer l’infrastructure de bureau virtuel et les environnements informatiques d’ingénierie : Définir la stratégie et la feuille de route relatives aux environnements VDI et aux solutions informatiques à distance pour l’ingénierie. Collaborer avec les équipes Infrastructure afin d’optimiser la performance, l’expérience utilisateur, l’accélération graphique et les charges de travail d’ingénierie. Définir les normes relatives aux postes de travail d’ingénierie, aux postes infonuagiques et aux modèles de prestation hybrides, tout en évaluant les technologies et les nouvelles approches de déploiement.
* Gouverner la demande, la livraison et les ressources : Superviser l’admission, la priorisation et la réalisation des initiatives technologiques d’ingénierie. Gérer l’affectation des ressources, la planification de la capacité des équipes et les priorités de livraison. Collaborer avec le CDS Front Door, le PMO, l’Architecture et les parties prenantes d’affaires afin d’assurer la bonne exécution des initiatives de plateforme, tout en surveillant la performance de livraison, les risques, les dépendances et la réalisation de la valeur.
* Renforcer la gouvernance des données et la gestion du cycle de vie de l’information : Définir les pratiques de gouvernance et de gestion du cycle de vie des données provenant des applications d’ingénierie. Élaborer des stratégies de conservation, d’archivage, de récupération, de conformité et d’accessibilité à long terme. Gouverner les environnements applicatifs hébergés par des fournisseurs ainsi que ceux hébergés dans l’environnement infonuagique de WSP. Collaborer avec les équipes Gouvernance des données, Sécurité, Juridique et Conformité afin de respecter les normes de l’entreprise et soutenir les stratégies favorisant l’analytique, l’IA et la livraison numérique.
* Accélérer l’innovation et l’adoption de technologies d’avenir : Évaluer les technologies émergentes, les services infonuagiques, les plateformes d’ingénierie alimentées par l’IA et les possibilités d’automatisation. Élaborer des feuilles de route technologiques adaptées à l’évolution des modèles de prestation en ingénierie. Cerner les possibilités d’amélioration de la productivité, de l’évolutivité, de la durabilité et de l’expérience utilisateur, et diriger des preuves de concept, projets pilotes d’innovation et programmes de modernisation technologique.
* Diriger la gouvernance des plateformes et la collaboration interfonctionnelle : Collaborer avec les équipes Infrastructure, Cybersécurité, Architecture d’entreprise et Opérations afin d’assurer l’alignement des plateformes. Définir les normes techniques, les pratiques de gestion du changement et les processus de gouvernance opérationnelle. Veiller à ce que les changements apportés aux plateformes d’ingénierie soient testés, documentés et soutenus sur le plan opérationnel, tout en assurant un leadership lors d’escalades techniques complexes et d’initiatives de plateforme à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
* Assurer la gestion financière et le leadership auprès de la haute direction : Gérer les budgets des plateformes, les prévisions, la planification des investissements et les initiatives d’optimisation. Élaborer des analyses de rentabilité et des recommandations d’investissement technologique. Favoriser l’optimisation des coûts liés à l’infonuagique, à l’infrastructure, à l’hébergement et aux services opérationnels, et produire des rapports destinés à la direction, des tableaux de bord, des présentations et des mises à jour de gouvernance.
* Développer l’équipe mondiale et le modèle opérationnel : Diriger et développer une équipe mondiale de spécialistes des plateformes et des technologies d’ingénierie. Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des modèles évolutifs de prestation et de soutien. Diriger la planification de la main-d’œuvre, le développement des capacités, le perfectionnement des compétences et la planification de la relève. Établir des structures de gouvernance et des modèles d’engagement pour les parties prenantes d’affaires et les équipes TI interfonctionnelles, tout en favorisant une culture de responsabilisation, d’innovation, de collaboration et d’amélioration continue.

**Les compétences qui vous distinguent**

* Formation et leadership des plateformes d’entreprise : Baccalauréat en technologies de l’information, informatique, ingénierie ou dans une discipline connexe, ainsi qu’une expérience significative dans la gestion de plateformes d’entreprise, de services d’infrastructure, de technologies infonuagiques ou d’environnements d’applications d’ingénierie.
* Expertise des environnements informatiques d’ingénierie : Expérience des environnements VDI, de l’informatique d’ingénierie, des plateformes d’hébergement infonuagique et de la prestation d’applications à l’échelle de l’entreprise. Une expérience des écosystèmes d’applications liés à l’ingénierie, au BIM, aux SIG/GIS, à la livraison numérique, à la simulation ou à la conception constitue un atout.
* Expertise en gouvernance des données : Solide compréhension des pratiques de gouvernance, de conservation, d’archivage et de gestion du cycle de vie des données, combinée à une connaissance des cadres d’architecture d’entreprise, de cybersécurité et de gouvernance des données.
* Leadership dans la réalisation d’initiatives complexes : Expérience de la gestion de portefeuilles de livraison technique et d’initiatives interfonctionnelles complexes. Expérience avec ITIL, Agile, SAFe ou des méthodologies de livraison comparables.
* Leadership mondial et modèles opérationnels : Expérience de la direction d’équipes techniques mondiales et de la transformation de modèles opérationnels.
* Gestion financière et investissements technologiques : Solide expérience de la gestion financière et des investissements technologiques, notamment en matière de budgets, de prévisions, de dossiers d’affaires, d’investissements et d’optimisation des coûts.
* Transformation infonuagique et modernisation : Expérience avec Microsoft Azure, les architectures cloud natives, les plateformes DaaS/VDI ainsi que les initiatives de modernisation de l’infrastructure. Expérience dans la direction de transformations infonuagiques et d’initiatives de modernisation des plateformes.
* Influence auprès des parties prenantes et de la haute direction : Excellentes aptitudes en gestion des parties prenantes, en communication avec la haute direction et en présentation. Excellente maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Title: Lead Software Engineer
Description:
Support Lead (Onshore)
  
  
**Location:**
PCS CA~TORONTO
  
  
**Years of Experience:**
10-15 Years
  
  
**Job Summary:**
We are seeking an experienced Support Lead to oversee and manage 24/7 production support operations for critical digital assets, tokenized deposits, stablecoin processing, and blockchain-enabled payment infrastructure. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring high availability, DLT node health, rapid incident resolution, and strict SLA adherence across multi-tiered financial and tokenization platforms.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead day-to-day production support operations, incident management, and problem management processes for tokenized deposit and payment platforms.
* Serve as the primary point of escalation for high-priority production incidents (P1/P2) involving token issuance, wallet custody integrations, or smart contract workflows.
* Oversee SLA compliance, transaction failure tracking, root cause analysis (RCA), and remediation for tokenized asset platforms.
* Manage shift handovers, on-call support rotas, and cross-location support coordination between onshore and offshore teams for high-availability payment networks.

**Mandatory Skills**

* 7+ years of experience in production/application support within Banking, Digital Payments, or Financial Technology domains.
* Hands-on background or strong working knowledge of tokenized deposits, digital asset operating models, stablecoins, or DLT/blockchain platforms.
* Proficiency with SQL, Unix/Linux shell scripting, and enterprise APM/logging tools (e.g., Splunk, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, Datadog).
* Strong ITIL process mastery (Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management).

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with digital wallet architectures, custody solutions, and cross-border payment messaging (e.g., ISO 20022, SWIFT).
* Understanding of cloud-hosted infrastructure (AWS/Azure) and containerized service monitoring (Docker/Kubernetes).
* Excellent crisis management, stakeholder communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* ITIL Foundation or blockchain/fintech certifications are a plus.

**Mackenzie Investments**

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025. It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Mackenzie Investments, founded in 1967, is a key part of IGM's business model, serving as a comprehensive asset-management partner for Canadian financial advisors and their clients.

**At Mackenzie Investments, we believe being invested starts with our people.** We are proud to be recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers for the fourth consecutive year and one of Canada’s Best Diversity Employers. Our vision and strategy aim to innovate the industry and support Canadians in achieving their financial goals.

Join our team to engage in continuous learning and skill development in a supportive environment. Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work environment, where you spend three days a week in the office, connecting, collaborating, and enjoying quality time with your amazing colleagues! Our Values: Be better; we strive for improvement in everything we do. Be accountable; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly. Be a team; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals.

**Role Overview**

* Deep expertise in provider reimbursement methodologies (DRG, per diem, fee schedules, capitation) and value-based and risk-based models
* Strong financial acumen, with the ability to evaluate complex financial models and translate claims and utilization data into negotiation strategy

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel

* Experience with Medicare Advantage and Medicaid contracting

Title: Program Communication Manager
Description:
19 Nov 2026

3 Dec 2026 - 00:00 UTC

Worldwide

Communications and Media

  

**ROLE PURPOSE**
  
The Program Communication Manager leads and assures high-quality, ethical, inclusive, evidence-based, and results-oriented communication for humanitarian programmes and projects, strengthening community engagement and accountability, supporting programme delivery and learning, meeting donor and contractual communication obligations, and documenting outcomes and impact.
  
The Program Communication Manager leads the planning, coordination, delivery, and monitoring of communication across humanitarian programmes and projects. The role ensures that communication is integrated throughout the programme and project lifecycle—from design and proposal development through implementation, monitoring, reporting, learning, and close-out—and that it contributes to programme quality, community engagement, accountability, donor requirements, visibility, and evidence of results.
  
**KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY**
  
**Programme and Project Communication Strategy and Planning**

* Develop and maintain programme/project communication strategies, plans, objectives, audience profiles, key messages, channels, timelines, responsibilities, budgets, and performance indicators.
* Ensure communication is considered at programme design and proposal stage, including communication needs, community information requirements, donor visibility, consent, safeguarding, accessibility, and risk.
* Translate programme objectives and theories of change into clear communication outcomes and audience-specific approaches.
* Coordinate communication plans across multiple programmes and projects to avoid duplication, identify shared opportunities, and manage competing priorities.
* Review plans regularly in response to context changes, community feedback, programme performance, emerging risks, and donor requirements.
* Lead the annual programme communication materials cycle (September to November): evaluate the previous year’s materials and publication performance, consolidate material needs from each project, and draft the annual plan of programme communication materials (objectives, audiences, key messages, material types, quarterly targets per project, and budget) aligned with the organizational communication strategy and master narrative, for approval by the Humanitarian & Program Operations Director.
* Work with the Brand and Comms Manager to align the approved annual plan with the organization’s annual publication calendar.

**Humanitarian Communication and Community Engagement**

* Oversee communication approaches that help affected communities access accurate, timely, understandable, accessible, and actionable information.
* Support two-way communication, community engagement, feedback, complaints referral, and information-sharing in coordination with programme teams and accountability/MEAL colleagues.
* Ensure communication is context-sensitive, conflict-sensitive, gender- and disability-inclusive, culturally appropriate, and adapted to language, literacy, age, and access needs.
* Coordinate communication support for preparedness, emergency response, recovery, risk communication, and other humanitarian programme phases as relevant to the organization’s mandate.
* Apply the humanitarian principles (humanity, neutrality, impartiality, and independence) and the do-no-harm principle in all programme communication, including communication with affected communities.
* During emergency response, prepare key messages, situation updates, and rapid-response information products with field operations and designated organizational spokespeople, aligned with the humanitarian response category (set by the humanitarian function within the first 24 hours) and delivered in line with the Categorization Framework in the Communication and Media Protocols, such as social media statements and blog posts (2 to 6 hours), press releases, case examples, and photographs (24 hours), and case studies (48 hours), in coordination with Strategic Communications.
* Ensure emergency communication carries the organization’s key humanitarian messages (scale of the emergency, impact on children, the response, advocacy asks, and appeal and fundraising needs), focuses on children and their long-term needs, speaks with one voice, and supports child protection and children’s rights.
* Ensure communication materials do not expose affected people, staff, partners, or communities to avoidable safety, protection, privacy, or reputational risks.

**Project Communication, Visibility, and Donor Compliance**

* Lead planning and delivery of project communication outputs, including stories of change, case studies, photographs, videos, social content, factsheets, human-interest materials, field updates, and communication inputs to reports.
* Translate donor visibility and acknowledgement requirements into practical workplans and quality checks, in coordination with grants, partnerships, programme, and Strategic Communications teams.
* Track communication deliverables and deadlines stated in proposals, grant agreements, contracts, communication plans, and donor guidance.
* Coordinate content collection with field teams and partners while minimizing disruption to programme delivery and avoiding extractive or harmful storytelling practices.
* Apply branding, marking, and co-branding rules to programme materials, including logo sequencing with donor and partner logos and logo proportions (a partner logo is never larger than the organization’s logo); where a donor specifies requirements, follow the donor’s procedure.

**Content Quality, Editorial Oversight, and Production**

* Set practical editorial, visual, accessibility, and quality standards for programme/project communication products, consistent with organizational policies and brand guidance.
* Oversee the editorial process from brief and commissioning through drafting, fact-checking, review, approval, production, publication, and archiving, acting as the initiator in the sign-off process: draft or commission the product, ensure relevant staff and resource persons have provided input and verified data, obtain sign-off from the decision maker, disseminate the product internally, and keep the record.
* Coordinate translation, interpretation, captioning, alternative formats, and local-language review as required.
* Maintain a content calendar and production pipeline, prioritizing urgent, contractual, high-impact, and time-sensitive deliverables.
* Chair the monthly materials planning meeting (final week of each month) to agree the materials to be produced and assign tasks, and ensure every brief is recorded in the material tracker before production begins.
* Review each programme material for accuracy, evidence, clarity, respectful and audience-appropriate content, and conformity with organizational values, the brand guideline, master narrative and key messages, donor visibility requirements, and the safeguarding checklist, completing each review round within two working days.
* Submit the complete publication package (final files, accompanying text, approval reference number, channel, and date) to Strategic Communications at least three working days before the planned publication date, and five to seven working days ahead where donor approval is required; for website and social media requests, state the content objectives, any partnership agreement conditions, and tagging details.
* Plan production schedules around the approval lead times in the Communication and Media Protocols (designed materials: two working days; media-relation items: three working days; national press releases: five; regional or global press releases: seven).
* Develop and approve programme and project content (such as project pages, field updates, and donor deliverables) and submit it to Strategic Communications, which holds publication rights for all official channels and media relations; neither the Manager nor programme and project staff publish programme materials directly or open social media accounts unless approved by Strategic Communications and recorded in the official account list. These procedures apply to programme and project materials, not organization-level materials.
* Ensure photography and video follow the organization’s imagery principles: focus on or refer to children, show staff naturally at work, pair imagery with copy that fits its objective, and capture authentic, unposed moments with context.

**Impact Communication, Evidence, Learning, and Reporting**

* Work with MEAL and programme teams to identify credible evidence of outputs, outcomes, community perspectives, and change; distinguish verified results from aspirations or anecdotal claims.
* Develop ethical and compelling narratives that explain the context, intervention, contribution, limitations, and observed changes without overstating attribution or impact.
* Define and monitor communication indicators such as reach, engagement, comprehension, feedback responsiveness, content quality, timeliness, and compliance.
* Produce regular performance updates, lessons learned, and recommendations for improving communication and programme practice.
* Ensure communication evidence is used to support programme learning, adaptive management, donor reporting, and appropriate external communication.

**Team Leadership and People Management**

* Directly manage, coach, and develop the Humanitarian Communication Coordinator and Project Communication Coordinator.
* Agree annual or project-based objectives, workplans, role clarity, performance indicators, and professional development priorities with each direct report.
* Allocate work and resources according to programme priorities, staff capacity, deadlines, context, and risk; resolve conflicting requests and escalate resource gaps.
* Conduct regular one-to-ones, team planning meetings, performance reviews, feedback, and learning sessions.
* Promote a respectful, inclusive, collaborative, and psychologically safe team culture, with clear standards for accountability and professional conduct.
* Identify staffing, consultant, vendor, equipment, and training needs and submit recommendations through the appropriate management and budget processes.

**Budget, Procurement, and Resource Management**

* Develop and manage communication budgets for assigned programmes/projects in coordination with budget holders and finance colleagues.
* Monitor expenditure, forecasts, cost-effectiveness, and budget compliance; flag variances and propose corrective action.
* Prepare scopes of work and technical briefs for photographers, videographers, designers, translators, printers, agencies, and other service providers.
* Support procurement and vendor selection in line with organizational policies, value-for-money principles, safeguarding requirements, and delegated approval limits.
* Maintain appropriate controls over equipment, digital assets, subscriptions, content production, and other communication resources.

**Risk Management, Safeguarding, Consent, and Data Protection**

* Apply organizational policies on safeguarding, protection, confidentiality, informed consent, data protection, information security, and responsible storytelling.
* Ensure consent is informed, voluntary, specific, appropriately documented, and revisited where context or intended use changes; consent must not be treated as a substitute for risk assessment.
* Use heightened safeguards for children and adults at heightened risk, including appropriate permissions, assent where relevant, anonymization, and review of potential harm.
* Assess risks associated with publication, geolocation, identifiable images, sensitive narratives, political or conflict contexts, and disclosure of operational information.
* Escalate suspected safeguarding concerns, data incidents, misinformation, harmful content, or serious reputational risks through established reporting channels promptly.
* Ensure team members and contractors understand and follow relevant policies before collecting, storing, producing, or publishing content.

**Coordination and Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with the Humanitarian & Program Operations Director, programme managers, project managers, field teams, MEAL, safeguarding, grants, finance, partnerships, and resource mobilization colleagues.
* Coordinate with Strategic Communications on organizational messages, brand identity, public statements, media engagement, sensitive topics, and content with organization-wide reputational implications.
* Pass programme content proposed for organization-level channels (website, main social media accounts, press releases) to Strategic Communications with consent, attribution, context, and usage rights documented.
* Strengthen partner capacity and ensure implementing partners apply the Communication and Media Protocols in both normal and emergency situations, that partnership agreements state that branding and marking follow the Protocols, and that partners are oriented on sign-off and co-branding requirements.
* Clarify roles, review steps, approval authority, escalation triggers, and response timelines with relevant teams to reduce bottlenecks and conflicting messages.
* Represent programme/project communication in relevant planning, review, coordination, and learning forums.
* Lead programme/project communication plans, delivery pipelines, field-oriented content, community communication, project visibility, and programme-level performance reporting within delegated authority, complementing the Strategic Communications function, which leads organization-wide positioning, institutional narrative, brand stewardship, media strategy, executive communications, and organization-level reputation.
* Agree and document coordination arrangements with Strategic Communications covering brand and editorial standards, publication workflows, escalation triggers, crisis coordination, and how programme evidence contributes to institutional narratives, supported by regular (weekly or bi-weekly) coordination meetings, a shared content calendar, and common brand and messaging guidelines.

**Crisis, Issues, and Incident Communication**

* Maintain programme/project-level communication risk assessments and escalation procedures in coordination with programme leadership and Strategic Communications.
* Support timely, accurate, and coordinated information for operational incidents, rapidly changing contexts, community concerns, and emerging misinformation.
* Provide verified programme facts, audience analysis, and field context to designated organizational spokespeople and decision-makers.
* Route all media enquiries to the Brand and Comms Manager; do not speak to the media unless designated as an authorized spokesperson, and do not issue institutional positions, media statements, or high-risk public responses outside delegated authority. Sensitive, political, and organizational matters are handled by the CEO; obtain required approvals and follow incident protocols.
* Participate in after-action reviews and update communication plans based on lessons learned.
* Provide verified facts and corrections for issues linked to programme materials, working with the response lead for the issue level: routine issues (isolated negative comments, misunderstandings) are answered by the Brand and Comms Manager with substantive clarification from the Program Communication Manager within one working day; issues (widespread criticism, misinformation about programmes, errors in published material, media questions) are co-led with the Sr. Manager Strategic Communications and the Program Manager within four hours; crises (safeguarding or privacy breaches, safety risks, impact on donor or government relationships) are supported with facts and corrections, with an interim statement within two hours; record each case in the programme communication issue and incident log and supply corrections to Strategic Communications.
* Support take-down decisions when consent is withdrawn or a content error is found by supplying facts; the decision and removal (each within 24 hours) rest with Strategic Communications.
* Be consulted on the same-day referral to the Safeguarding Focal Point (immediately where there is a risk of harm) of any report of abuse, exploitation, or a person at risk received through publication channels on programme content.
* Escalate statements on sensitive political or conflict issues, major incidents, allegations, high-risk media requests, CEO/board matters, and issues with organization-wide reputational impact through the designated approval and incident protocols, without bypassing reporting lines or assuming approval authority not explicitly delegated.

**Systems, Knowledge Management, and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain accurate, organized, secure, and accessible records and repositories of approved content, source files, approvals, consent, attribution, usage rights, donor acknowledgements and visibility evidence, published outputs, and communication reports.
* Establish repeatable workflows, templates, briefing formats, quality-assurance checklists, and approval tracking for programme/project communication.
* Promote appropriate use of digital tools, analytics, multimedia, and accessible formats while following organizational data and security requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce duplication, strengthen local capacity, and increase the usefulness of communication to communities and programme teams.
* Ensure proper handover, archiving, and closure of communication assets and obligations at project end.

**Field Content, Livestreaming, and Rapid Publishing**

* Lead planning of field content for visits by the Program Communication Team: prepare the Field Content Plan (location, period, channel, format, risk level, and content objectives) at least ten working days before departure, and obtain pre-approval from the Sr. Manager Strategic Communications (or the decision maker for the risk level) before travel; pre-approval is valid only for the location, period, channel, and format stated in the plan.
* Ensure only staff designated as focal points by Strategic Communications, trained and listed under the Spokesperson Appointment Policy, produce and publish field content, using official devices and temporary publication access only; personal devices must not be used to access official accounts. The procedure covers the organization’s official Instagram (Live and Story) and YouTube (Live and Shorts) accounts.
* Ensure informed consent is obtained before filming or photographing, in coordination with the Safeguarding Focal Point and the Program Manager.
* Oversee live broadcasts and quick content so that they follow the approved plan, pass the content checklist before publication, and are approved at the level set by the risk-based approval matrix under Decision-Making Authority.
* Ensure immediate action when an incident occurs: the team stops the broadcast, redirects the camera, or takes down quick content when a person without consent is recorded, personal data or a sensitive location is visible, security conditions change or an objection is raised, a participant is distressed or asks to stop, or Strategic Communications requests it. Report the incident to the responsible manager and the Brand and Comms Manager within 30 minutes, and report lost or damaged official devices immediately.
* Ensure publication access is returned and official devices are handed back within one working day after the team returns, and that the post-field report (reach, engagement, donations where relevant, and incidents) is completed within five working days.
* Evaluate the livestreaming and quick-content procedure each quarter (including the November review) with the Fundraising Manager, and update it with Strategic Communications, the Safeguarding Focal Point, and the Technology and Digital Unit.

**Fundraising and Resource Mobilization Support**

* Provide programme communication support for fundraising and resource mobilization across all income streams, including institutional donors, individual giving, Islamic giving, domestic and international corporate partners, and other sources, in line with priorities agreed with the Humanitarian & Program Operations Director and the fundraising teams.
* Supply verified programme facts, results, stories of change, case studies, photographs, and videos for concept notes, proposals, pitch materials, appeals, campaigns, and donor or partner reports, tailored to each audience and income stream.
* Contribute communication and visibility plans, budgets, and evidence of results to institutional donor proposals and reports, in coordination with the grants and partnerships teams.
* Support individual giving and Islamic giving campaigns and supporter updates with authentic programme content and impact information that accurately reflects how funds are used, following the requirements set by the responsible fundraising teams.
* Support domestic and international corporate partnerships with programme content for partnership proposals, employee engagement, co-branded materials, and impact reporting, applying the organization’s branding and co-branding rules.
* Support donor and corporate partner field visits, emergency appeals, and fundraising field content, obtaining approvals under the risk-based approval matrix, and ensure fundraising use of programme content respects consent scope, safeguarding, data protection, and donor restrictions, without overstating results or using extractive imagery.

**QUALIFICATIONS**
  
**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, public relations, media studies, development studies, international relations, or a related field.
* Typically 5–7 years of progressively responsible experience in communications, including experience supporting programmes/projects; relevant organizational context may justify a different threshold.

**Experience and Skills**

* Demonstrated experience developing and implementing communication plans and producing high-quality written, visual, and digital content.
* Experience coordinating multiple deliverables, stakeholders, deadlines, and budgets.
* Experience with donor visibility requirements, ethical storytelling, consent, safeguarding, and risk-sensitive communications.
* Experience managing or supervising staff, consultants, agencies, or production vendors.
* Programme/project cycle management and ability to integrate communication into design, implementation, monitoring, reporting, and learning.
* Strong writing, editing, interviewing, storytelling, briefing, and content quality-assurance skills in the working languages of the role (for example Bahasa Indonesia and English), including review of translated materials.
* Understanding of community engagement, accountability to affected populations, inclusive communication, and accessible information.
* Understanding of safeguarding, informed consent, privacy, data protection, and responsible representation of affected people.
* Knowledge of donor visibility and communication compliance processes, branding and co-branding rules, sign-off and risk-based approval processes, and live and short-form video publishing on social media platforms.
* Ability to use digital publishing tools, content management systems, social media tools, analytics, and common office/productivity software.
* Budgeting, work planning, prioritization, vendor coordination, and basic performance measurement.

**Desirable**

* A relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Experience producing communication content for fundraising, such as institutional donor proposals, individual or Islamic giving campaigns, and corporate partnerships.
* Experience in humanitarian action, international development, civil society, or community-based programming is strongly preferred.

**Operations Manager**
to lead a team responsible for cloud infrastructure operations, client disaster recovery environments, operational project delivery, and enterprise healthcare technology solutions.
  
  
This position combines
**people leadership, cloud operations, project management, and client relationship management**
. This role requires someone comfortable balancing managerial responsibilities with operational execution, including cloud resource provisioning, network configuration requests, disaster recovery coordination, infrastructure troubleshooting, and healthcare application support coordination.
  
  
***This role will be based in Nashville TN - we do offer relocation assistance***
**Responsibilities**
**People Management & Team Leadership**

* Provide direct management, coaching, mentoring, and professional development for a team of approximately 8 operations associates.
* Manage day-to-day team operations, including workload distribution, project assignments, support responsibilities, and resource planning.
* Establish, maintain, and coordinate on-call rotations to ensure appropriate coverage for production environments, critical infrastructure, and client support needs.
* Monitor team capacity and priorities to ensure project commitments and operational support obligations are met.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance evaluations, development discussions, and team meetings.
* Provide guidance, training, and mentorship to project managers and operations associates.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement across the team.
* Coordinate escalations, remove operational blockers, and ensure critical issues receive appropriate attention and resolution.

**Disaster Recovery Operations & Client Project Management**

* Lead and coordinate client disaster recovery (DR) infrastructure projects from initial planning through implementation, validation, and ongoing operational support.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders regarding disaster recovery environments, project timelines, infrastructure requirements, and operational readiness.
* Facilitate recurring weekly client meetings to review DR environment health, project progress, outstanding issues, upcoming changes, and operational priorities.
* Provide regular status reports, project updates, risk assessments, and action-item tracking for client disaster recovery environments.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, networking, virtualization, and application teams to ensure disaster recovery environments meet established operational requirements.
* Oversee infrastructure provisioning, configuration requests, maintenance activities, and environment readiness.
* Track project milestones, dependencies, infrastructure issues, and deliverables using Jira and other project management tools.

Description:

We are committed to powering and protecting the infrastructure that keeps businesses and communities running—whether during daily operations or times of disaster.

**Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Fueling for Data Center**
================================================================================

**Cat5 Resources**

**Position summary**
--------------------

The Project Manager leads Cat5’s preventive maintenance and fueling program for a national wireless infrastructure client, with a fleet made up mostly of portable generators. The role coordinates scheduled maintenance, routine and emergency fuel deliveries, portable unit deployment and recovery, field personnel and vendors, safety, client communications, and complete service and fuel-delivery documentation.

**Department**

Operations – Generator Services

  

**Reports to**

Director of Operations

  

**Location**

Mostly on-site in North Texas, with travel to vendor shops and field sites

  

**Type**

Full-time, exempt

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Program and client management**

* Serve as the client’s main point of contact; run regular status meetings and escalations.

* Build and manage the program plan, budget, staffing and subcontractor mix (in-house vs. third party).

* Get all subcontractors through the client’s qualification process before they access any site.

* Track and report performance against contract SLAs: preventive maintenance completion, on-time fueling, emergency response, fuel-delivery accuracy and work-order closeout.

* Protect client confidential information.

* Turn around client quote requests and purchase orders quickly, within contract response times.

* Track every scheduled maintenance visit and fueling commitment; flag at-risk work orders early and communicate revised completion dates.

**Preventive maintenance and fueling operations**

* Oversee scheduled preventive maintenance inspections and servicing of portable generators and, where applicable, installed generators and automatic transfer switches (ATS).

* Review maintenance findings, identify deficiencies and coordinate escalation of repair needs to the appropriate repair team for client approval.

* Plan recurring generator fueling, fuel-level checks and emergency refueling based on client requirements, site access and generator operating needs.

* Coordinate routine portable generator checks, operational testing and follow-up on deficiencies identified during preventive maintenance, including ATS checks where applicable.

* Enforce quality standards through maintenance checklists, fuel-delivery tickets, meter readings, photographs and complete site-level work-order records.

* Investigate missed services, fueling discrepancies, fuel shortages and repeat service issues; document corrective actions.

* Ensure preventive maintenance and fueling activities follow applicable safety, spill-prevention, environmental and fuel-handling requirements.

* Ensure technicians record generator condition, alarms, fluid levels, battery checks, fuel levels and test results during service visits.

* Obtain required client approvals for nonroutine fueling, emergency deliveries and out-of-scope maintenance before proceeding.

* Maintain complete preventive maintenance and fueling history for each serviced asset and site.

* Track portable generator inventory, location, deployment, transport and return, recording unit ID, run hours and condition at each move.

* Coordinate qualified maintenance subcontractors, fuel suppliers and delivery partners when work cannot be self-performed.

* Escalate generator faults, fuel-system concerns, suspected leaks and repair needs with supporting site documentation.

**Fuel, parts and materials management**

* Maintain availability of preventive maintenance supplies, filters, fluids and approved fueling resources.

* Forecast maintenance supplies and fuel-delivery demand based on schedules, site consumption and seasonal or emergency needs.

* Publish reports on fuel deliveries, consumption, maintenance supplies, missed visits and service delays.

* Coordinate approved fuel suppliers and maintenance-material vendors, including delivery coverage and service expectations.

* Record maintenance materials, delivered fuel quantities, delivery confirmations and associated costs in designated systems.

* Use maintenance schedules, historical fuel usage and generator run time to plan service materials and fueling requirements.

* Review fuel-supply capacity, delivery lead times and critical maintenance materials with the client.

* Support client audits of maintenance records, fuel tickets, invoices and vendor compliance.

**Field operations and technician coordination**

* Assign preventive maintenance routes, fueling dispatches and portable generator deployments based on geography, site priority and personnel qualifications.

* Monitor technician and fuel-vendor productivity, service quality, safety compliance and work-order completion.

* Coordinate follow-up maintenance visits, missed fuel deliveries and client communication for incomplete work.

**Scheduling, dispatch and work-order management**

* Manage multi-site preventive maintenance schedules, fueling routes, dispatch priorities and travel logistics.

* Complete scheduled preventive maintenance and fuel deliveries within contractual service windows.

* Escalate missed appointments, access issues, low-fuel conditions and delivery delays; keep the client informed.

* Track maintenance and fueling work orders, assigned personnel, delivery dates, gallons delivered and outstanding actions.

* Close out each work order with service details, fuel quantities, delivery tickets, photographs and client-required documentation.

* Investigate recurring service exceptions, fuel discrepancies, incomplete deliveries and quality concerns.

* Ensure proper handling of fuels and service waste, including spill response and reporting under applicable procedures.

**Site services**

* Plan preventive maintenance visits, routine fueling, emergency refueling and portable generator deployment at tower and other remote sites with client operations teams.

* Make sure field technicians hold the required electrical and mechanical certifications and follow site safety rules.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of project or program management in field services, maintenance, fuel logistics or telecom infrastructure.

* 3+ years working with portable and standby diesel or natural gas generators; automatic transfer switch (ATS) experience is a plus.

* Working knowledge of Generac, Kohler and other portable generator platforms and their controllers.

* Experience managing generator preventive maintenance and fueling programs with field documentation and quality controls.

* Experience with fuel logistics, delivery verification, vendor coordination and maintenance-material planning.

* Experience managing subcontractors and vendors, including qualification, scheduling and performance.

* Comfortable working from contract terms: POs, work orders, SLAs, fueling requirements and service scopes.

* Strong Excel skills and experience with field service, maintenance management or work-order systems.

* Clear written reporting to an enterprise client on a daily, weekly and monthly cadence.

* Able to work independently and remotely, and to manage on-site work from a distance.

* Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* EGSA Generator Technician certification, or prior hands-on generator technician experience.

* Experience with tower or cell-site backup power programs for a national carrier or tower company.

* Experience with generator fueling, emergency fuel delivery, fuel monitoring and remote field service.

* Knowledge of applicable environmental and safety requirements for fuel, fluids, batteries and field maintenance.

* Familiarity with OSHA 10/30 and site-access qualification for subcontractors.

* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

* Based primarily at our Power Solutions location in North Texas, with coordination of remote field operations.

* Travel to fuel vendors, maintenance partners and field sites, up to 40% of the time.

* Availability outside normal hours for emergency fueling, portable generator deployment, generator outages and storm response.

* Field visits involve tower-site conditions, heat, noise, outdoor weather and required PPE.

* Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs and walk uneven ground at sites.

**Success measures**
--------------------

* On-time preventive maintenance completion, fueling delivery and work-order closeout.

* Fueling dispatch, emergency delivery and maintenance response within contract requirements.

* Every maintenance visit and fuel delivery documented with required readings, quantities and asset identification.

* Daily, weekly and monthly client reports delivered complete and on time.

* Improved generator readiness, fewer low-fuel incidents and timely resolution of maintenance deficiencies.

* Accurate fuel reconciliation, strong safety performance and zero unauthorized work.

* Invoices submitted promptly after work is accepted.

---------------------

Employment may be contingent on a background check and drug screen.

**Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Repairs**
================================================================

**Cat5 Resources**

**Position summary**
--------------------

The Project Manager runs Cat5’s nationwide generator preventive maintenance and repair program for a national wireless infrastructure client with thousands of backup power units in service across the U.S. The role owns the full asset lifecycle: receiving decommissioned generators and ATS units, deciding repair vs. dispose, overseeing refurbishment and testing, managing stored inventory, and fulfilling orders to sites on time.

Operations – Generator Services

Director of Operations

Remote with travel to field sites or client location if needed

Full-time, exempt

* Build and manage the program plan, budget, staffing and subcontractor mix (in-house vs. third party).
* Get all subcontractors through the client’s qualification process before they access any site.
* Maintain and update Cat5’s hours and company information in Avetta so qualification and compliance status stay current.
* Track and report performance against contract SLAs: preventive maintenance completion, repair response times, first-time fix rates, equipment uptime and work-order closeout.

* Turn around client quote requests and purchase orders quickly, within contract response times.

* Ensure technicians document generator operating conditions, alarms, fluid levels, battery condition and test results during site visits.
* Submit repair quotes for client approval and do not perform work requiring authorization before written approval is received.
* Maintain complete preventive maintenance and repair history for each client-owned asset.
* Coordinate qualified subcontractors and specialty repair vendors when work cannot be self-performed.
* Escalate generators requiring major repair or replacement recommendations with supporting diagnostics and cost estimates.

**Parts and materials management**

* Maintain availability of service parts, filters, fluids, batteries and critical repair components.
* Monitor critical parts stock and forecast material requirements based on scheduled maintenance and repair trends.
* Publish reports on parts usage, open repairs, backorders and material-related service delays.
* Source OEM-approved or client-authorized replacement parts through approved vendors.
* Record parts consumption and purchasing in designated systems and provide required client reporting.
* Use maintenance schedules and historical consumption to plan recurring service materials.
* Review critical spare-parts levels and lead times with the client.

Title: Project Manager- Generator Refurbishment
Description:
**About Cat5 Resources LLC**

**Cat5 Resources is a certified Woman-Owned Business providing technical and operational services to critical infrastructure across the Southern US, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands.**

Since 2013, we’ve supported telecommunications, utilities, and essential industries with services including **Disaster Recovery, Operations and Maintenance, Electrical, Civil and Construction, and Transportation and Logistics.** In 2016, we expanded into Puerto Rico with **Cat5 Caribbean**, and in 2024, we launched **Cat5 Power Solutions** to deliver portable power sales and rentals across the region.

We are committed to powering and protecting the infrastructure that keeps businesses and communities running—whether during daily operations or times of disaster.

**Position summary**
--------------------

The Project Manager runs Cat5’s nationwide generator refurbishment and replenishment program for a national wireless infrastructure client with thousands of backup power units in service across the U.S. The role owns the full asset lifecycle: receiving decommissioned generators and ATS units, deciding repair vs. dispose, overseeing refurbishment and testing, managing stored inventory, and fulfilling orders to sites on time.

**Department**

Operations – Generator Services

**Reports to**

Director of Operations

**Location**

Mostly on-site at our Power Solutions location in Jasper, TX, with travel to vendor shops and field sites
